This is an official notice (皖教秘高〔2025〕39号) from the Anhui Provincial Department of Education announcing the 5th National College Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition (Anhui Division), to be held April-May 2025, hosted by Anhui Normal University.

**Key organizational details:**
- Theme: "Promote Teaching Innovation, Cultivate First-Class Talents"
- Targets: Advance "Four New" disciplines construction, curriculum ideological-political education (课程思政), and industry-education integration (产教融合)

**Eligibility:**
- In-service teachers at all undergraduate institutions in Anhui (including military academies)
- Main teachers must have taught the course at least 2 rounds in the past 5 years
- Industry-education integration track requires team participation with at least 1 part-time teacher from industry (engaged 2+ years)
- Winners of 1st prize in previous national competitions cannot re-enter; 2nd/3rd prize winners cannot compete consecutively

**Competition structure (7 tracks, 20 groups):**
1. New Engineering (正高/副高/中级及以下)
2. New Medicine
3. New Agriculture
4. New Liberal Arts
5. Basic Courses
6. Curriculum Ideological-Political Education
7. Industry-Education Integration (central ministries vs. local universities)
- Encouraged fields: AI, integrated circuits, quantum tech, energy storage, smart manufacturing, digital economy, bioseed, smart agriculture, international communication, etc.

**Timeline (2025):**
- April 16: School administrator system registration
- April 30: Entry materials (classroom videos, innovation reports) submitted to system at https://nticct.cahe.edu.cn/
- May 2: School admin review and submission
- May 9: Network evaluation completion
- May 15: Network review shortlist announced
- May 25: On-site evaluation at Anhui Normal University
- May 28: Results announced
- June 10: National competition candidate list uploaded

**Scoring (100 points total):**
- Network review (60 pts): Classroom video (40 pts) + Innovation report (20 pts)
- On-site review (40 pts): 12-min teaching design presentation + 8-min Q&A

**Quota allocation:**
- Total 703 slots across 51 institutions
- China University of Science and Technology: 19; Hefei University of Technology: 20; Anhui University: 21; Anhui Normal University: 18; most other universities: 12-17
- Basis: "Double First-Class" universities get 15 slots, universities named "University" get 12, others get 8 for tracks 1-5
- School bonus: 3 slots for national 1st prize last year, 1 slot for 2nd prize; host gets 2 bonus slots
- Anhui recommends 19 teachers for national competition (14 for tracks 1-5, 2 for track 6, 3 for track 7); at least 1/3 must be senior title

**Awards:**
- Individual/team: 1st/2nd/3rd prizes at approximately 10%/20%/30% of provincial participants
- Outstanding Organization Award: about 20% of participating universities

**Material requirements:**
- Application form, innovation report (max 4000 words), two 1-class-hour complete classroom videos (MP4, 720P+, max 1200MB each), teaching syllabus, course proof from academic system
- Industry-education track requires evidence of 30%+ practical teaching hours and 2+ years industry cooperation
- No personal identity info allowed in materials (exceptions for industry-education track)
- No academic misconduct or disciplinary violations permitted

第六届全国高校教师教学创新大赛是经教育部批准，由[中国高等教育学会](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E9%AB%98%E7%AD%89%E6%95%99%E8%82%B2%E5%AD%A6%E4%BC%9A/8489806?fromModule=lemma_inlink)主办的全国性教学竞赛 [1-2]。大赛以“推动教学创新 培养一流人才”为主题，旨在推动高等教育教学改革，助力[新工科](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%96%B0%E5%B7%A5%E7%A7%91/20597803?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[新医科](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%96%B0%E5%8C%BB%E7%A7%91/23225429?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[新农科](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%96%B0%E5%86%9C%E7%A7%91/23164090?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[新文科](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%96%B0%E6%96%87%E7%A7%91/23137059?fromModule=lemma_inlink)建设，推进[课程思政](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%AF%BE%E7%A8%8B%E6%80%9D%E6%94%BF/22421661?fromModule=lemma_inlink)与[产教融合](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BA%A7%E6%95%99%E8%9E%8D%E5%90%88/22168164?fromModule=lemma_inlink)，深化人工智能技术赋能教学创新。大赛采用校赛、省赛、全国赛三级赛制 [2-3]，设有新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科、基础课程、课程思政、产教融合、人工智能、实验教学共9个赛道。参赛对象为全国普通本科高等学校和军队院校的在职教师，比赛内容包括课堂教学实录视频、教学创新成果报告和教学设计创新汇报 [2]。

全国高校教师教学创新大赛自2020年启动，已得到全国32个赛区、1200多所高校的重视，数万名教师（团队）参赛 [5] [8]。该大赛是唯一一项纳入《教育部直属单位三评一竞赛保留项目清单》的面向各学科、各专业、各职称教师参加的综合性教师教学竞赛 [7] [13]。

2026年7月20-23日，第六届全国教师教学创新大赛现场赛在南京大学、南京理工大学举行，大赛覆盖全国32个赛区所有本科高校，共13.8万名教师参加校赛，4.5万名教师参加省赛，699门课程的2697名教师(含团队教师)最终入围全国现场赛评审。西安交大2门课程进入现场赛，分别荣获一、二等奖。 [22]全国总决赛中，[北京科技大学](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%8C%97%E4%BA%AC%E7%A7%91%E6%8A%80%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%A6/136975?fromModule=lemma_inlink)储继迅教学团队获“基础课程正高组”一等奖。 [26]

## 赛道设置与参赛要求

播报

编辑

第六届全国高校教师教学创新大赛共设置[新工科](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%96%B0%E5%B7%A5%E7%A7%91/20597803?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[新医科](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%96%B0%E5%8C%BB%E7%A7%91/23225429?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[新农科](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%96%B0%E5%86%9C%E7%A7%91/23164090?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[新文科](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%96%B0%E6%96%87%E7%A7%91/23137059?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[基础课程](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9F%BA%E7%A1%80%E8%AF%BE%E7%A8%8B/12752875?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[课程思政](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%AF%BE%E7%A8%8B%E6%80%9D%E6%94%BF/22421661?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[产教融合](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BA%A7%E6%95%99%E8%9E%8D%E5%90%88/22168164?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[人工智能](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BA%BA%E5%B7%A5%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD/24604211?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[实验教学](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%AE%9E%E9%AA%8C%E6%95%99%E5%AD%A6/1374724?fromModule=lemma_inlink)共9个赛道 [2]。其中，“四新”建设（即新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科）、基础课程、课程思政赛道下设正高组、副高组、中级及以下组；产教融合赛道按高校类型分组，下设部属高校、地方高校2个小组；人工智能和实验教学为新增赛道 [7]。

参赛对象为全国普通本科高等学校和军队院校的在职教师。其中，主讲教师近5年对所参赛的本科课程讲授2轮及以上，且参赛课程需纳入本科人才培养方案 [2]。

产教融合赛道要求以团队形式参赛，团队成员至少包含1名从行业企业聘请的兼职教师，且深度参与教育教学时间须达到2年及以上 [3]。

已获得往届大赛全国赛一等奖的主讲教师不能再次参赛，已获得上届大赛全国赛二、三等奖的主讲教师不能连续参赛 [2]。

参赛教师提交的相关材料和现场汇报环节中均不得出现参赛教师姓名、所在高校及院系名称等透露个人身份的信息 [2]。

## 比赛内容与形式

播报

编辑

大赛的比赛内容包括课堂教学实录视频、创新成果报告和教学设计创新汇报 [2]。参赛教师需要提交课堂教学实录视频、创新成果报告（或课程思政创新报告、产教融合创新报告）和教学设计创新汇报等材料 [3]。

大赛通常分为网络评审和现场赛两个阶段 [11]。网络评审主要依据提交的课堂教学实录视频、创新成果报告等材料 [1]。

现场赛环节通常包括教学创新成果汇报和现场讲课/答辩，例如要求参赛教师进行不超过12分钟的教学设计创新汇报（PPT展示） [12]，或进行5分钟的教学创新成果汇报和10分钟的现场讲课，随后进行专家提问交流 [14]。

大赛评审维度涵盖教学理念、教学设计、教学实施、教学效果、创新点价值等多个方面 [16]。

## 赛事意义与实施案例

播报

编辑

大赛旨在以赛促教、以赛促改、以赛促建，打造高校教师教学创新与交流的标杆。 [2] [11]根据大赛安排，全国赛获奖课程的课堂教学实录视频经授权后，将上线国家智慧教育公共服务平台进行展示，以发挥优秀教学成果的示范引领作用。 [1-2]

在2026年举办的第六届全国教师教学创新大赛中，大赛规模进一步扩大，覆盖全国32个赛区所有本科高校，共13.8万名教师参加校赛，4.5万名教师参加省赛，699门课程的2697名教师入围全国现场赛评审。 [22]本届大赛共有1308所高校参赛。 [29]

各地各高校积极组织实施，例如[深圳大学](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%B7%B1%E5%9C%B3%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%A6/423814?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[滇西应用技术大学](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%BB%87%E8%A5%BF%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%A6/15508024?fromModule=lemma_inlink)等高校完成了校赛并公布获奖名单；山西省由省教育厅主办并由相关高校承办赛区赛事；陕西省、安徽省等赛区则开展了严格的参赛教师选拔与推荐工作。 [4] [6] [10-11] [19]为提升教师备赛质量，许多高校举办了专题讲座、培训指导会等活动，例如[长春师范大学](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E9%95%BF%E6%98%A5%E5%B8%88%E8%8C%83%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%A6/781199?fromModule=lemma_inlink)举办了备赛系列讲座，邀请专家解析大赛要求与材料撰写；生态与环境学院组织了院级选拔与指导会，由资深专家对参赛教师进行现场点评。 [15] [18]

[湖南人文科技学院](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%B9%96%E5%8D%97%E4%BA%BA%E6%96%87%E7%A7%91%E6%8A%80%E5%AD%A6%E9%99%A2/417227?fromModule=lemma_inlink)也在大赛中获奖，进一步展示了以赛促教的成效。 [28]此外，[珠海科技学院](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E7%8F%A0%E6%B5%B7%E7%A7%91%E6%8A%80%E5%AD%A6%E9%99%A2/53960193?fromModule=lemma_inlink)计算机学院李晨瑜教学团队凭借《人工智能导论》课程的教学创新，荣获第六届大赛基础课程中级及以下组二等奖。 [29]

大赛结果通常设有个人（团队）奖和优秀组织奖。 [6] [17]在校赛、省赛阶段获奖的教师（团队）将有机会被择优推荐，参加更高层级的省赛或全国赛。 [9] [19]

args.key_excerpts: 大赛以"推动教学创新 培养一流人才"为主题。该赛事是唯一一项纳入教育部《直属单位三评一竞赛保留项目清单》的高校教师教学竞赛，已成为全国高校教师教学创新的标杆展示与交流平台。2026年7月20-23日现场赛在南京大学、南京理工大学举行，覆盖全国32个赛区所有本科高校，共13.8万名教师参加校赛，4.5万名教师参加省赛，699门课程的2697名教师最终入围全国现场赛评审。本届大赛共有1308所高校参赛。北京科技大学储继迅教学团队获"基础课程正高组"一等奖。
args.summary:
第六届全国高校教师教学创新大赛是经教育部批准、由中国高等教育学会主办的全国性教学竞赛，主题为"推动教学创新 培养一流人才"。赛事旨在推动高等教育教学改革，助力新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科建设，推进课程思政与产教融合，并深化人工智能赋能教学创新。

【组织架构】大赛由教育部高等教育司指导、中国高等教育学会主办，南京大学、南京理工大学、复旦大学、西安交通大学、浙江大学、电子科技大学、北京理工大学共同承办，北京世纪超星信息技术发展有限责任公司和高等教育出版社有限公司支持。大赛设组织委员会、专家委员会、纪律与监督委员会和仲裁委员会。

【赛制与赛道】大赛采用校赛、省赛、全国赛三级赛制，共设置新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科、基础课程、课程思政、产教融合、人工智能、实验教学共9个赛道。其中"四新"、基础课程、课程思政赛道下设正高组、副高组、中级及以下组；产教融合赛道分部属高校、地方高校2个小组；人工智能和实验教学为新增赛道。

【参赛要求】参赛对象为全国普通本科高校和军队院校的在职教师。主讲教师近5年需对所参赛本科课程讲授2轮及以上，参赛课程须纳入本科人才培养方案。产教融合赛道要求团队至少包含1名从行业企业聘请的兼职教师且深度参与教育教学2年及以上。已获往届全国赛一等奖的主讲教师不能再次参赛，二、三等奖获得者不能连续参赛。

【赛程安排】校赛为2025年11月至2026年1月，省赛为2026年2月至4月，全国赛网络评审为2026年5月至6月，全国赛现场赛于2026年7月20日至23日在南京大学、南京理工大学举行。大赛官网为nticct.cahe.edu.cn。

【规模数据】本届大赛覆盖全国32个赛区所有本科高校，共1308所高校参赛，13.8万名教师参加校赛、4.5万名教师参加省赛，699门课程的2697名教师入围全国现场赛评审。

【比赛内容】包括课堂教学实录视频、创新成果报告和教学设计创新汇报。现场赛通常包括不超过12分钟的教学设计创新汇报、5分钟成果汇报和10分钟现场讲课，随后专家提问交流。

【赛况亮点】北京科技大学储继迅教学团队获"基础课程正高组"一等奖；西安交大2门课程进入现场赛获一、二等奖；同济大学获上海市特等奖6项、名列上海高校第一；福建省24个团队入围现场评审获一等奖6项、江苏大学田丰伟和孙丝丝团队获新农科、新文科正高组全国二等奖；湖南人文科技学院获新农科中级以下组二等奖第一名；珠海科技学院成为广东省唯一获国赛奖项的民办本科高校。

【赛事意义】该大赛是唯一一项纳入教育部《直属单位三评一竞赛保留项目清单》的综合性教师教学竞赛，全国赛获奖课程的课堂教学实录视频经授权后将上线国家智慧教育公共服务平台展示。

# 关于举办学校首届教师教学创新大赛的通知

时间：2021-01-13浏览：984

各教学院部：

根据《关于举办首届全国高校教师教学创新大赛的通知》（高学会[2020]107号）（**附件1**）和《教育部高等教育司转发<关于举办首届全国高校教师教学创新大赛的通知>的函》的文件精神及要求，学校拟举办首届教师教学创新大赛，现将相关事宜通知如下：

**一、大赛主题**

推动教学创新 打造一流课程

二、**参赛对象**

我校在职或正式聘用教师，主讲教师近五年对参赛的本科课程讲授3轮及以上。以个人或团队形式报名，鼓励以团队形式参赛，团队成员包括1名主讲教师和不超过3名团队教师。

**三、比赛安排**

各院部报名人数不限，比赛设置正高组、副高组、中级及以下组三个组别，分为三个阶段。

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **比赛阶段** | **内容** | **时间** |
| 第一阶段 | 学校组织专家对参赛教师的《申报书》（详见**附件3-****1**）、《课程教学大纲》（详见**附件3-****2**）、《课程教学创新成果报告》（要求见**附件1**）进行评审，确定参加第二阶段比赛的选手名单。 | 1月25-29日 |
| 第二阶段 | 教学创新设计汇报。参赛教师结合教学大纲和教学实践，说明整门课程的设计思路，突出教学改革与创新，展示相关过程性支撑材料。汇报时间不超过15分钟。 | 3月1-5日（具体时间另行通知） |
| 第三阶段 | 课堂教学实录视频评审。进入第二阶段参赛教师提交课堂教学实录视频及相关材料（要求见**附件1**），学校组织专家进行评审。综合考虑三个阶段比赛成绩，最终确定获奖教师名单。 | 3月13-15日 |

**四、奖项设置**

比赛设一、二、三等奖，获奖名额根据参赛教师情况确定。届时将择优推荐获奖教师参加山东省教师教学创新大赛。

**五、有关要求**

1.各院部应高度重视“学校首届教师教学创新大赛”工作，积极做好院部选拔推荐工作，具体评审标准见**附件2**。

2.请各教学院部于**1月15日12:00之前**报送《推荐教师汇总表》（**附件4**）并加盖学院公章，参赛教师请加入**QQ群：892590352**。

3.请各教学院部于**1月25日12:00之前**提交比赛第一阶段所需《申报书》《课程教学大纲》《课程教学创新成果报告》等材料。

4.请各教学院部于**3月12日17:00****之前**提交课堂教学实录视频（标准详见**附件3-3**）及相关材料。相关材料包括:课堂教学实录视频信息表(详见**附件3-4**)、课堂教学实录视频内容对应的教案和课件，以及其他有助于表明课堂教学内容、教学过程、教学效果的材料。

5.**所有材料**的电子版请发送至：LXH2014@upc.edu.cn。

 

其他未尽事宜，请与党委教师工作部、教师教学发展中心联系，联系人：刘旭华，联系电话：0532-86983202。

args.summary:
This is a notice posted on the China University of Petroleum (UPC) College of Pipeline and Civil Engineering's undergraduate student webpage, dated January 13, 2021, announcing the school's first Teachers' Teaching Innovation Competition (首届教师教学创新大赛). The competition theme is "Promoting Teaching Innovation, Creating First-Class Courses" (推动教学创新 打造一流课程).

Key details:
- **Eligibility**: Current or formally employed teachers at UPC who have taught their undergraduate course at least 3 rounds within the past 5 years. Participation can be individual or team-based (1 lead teacher + up to 3 team teachers).
- **Competition format**: Three groups (Senior/正高, Associate/副高, and Mid-level and below/中级及以下), held in three stages:
  1. Stage 1 (Jan 25-29): Expert review of application form, course syllabus, and teaching innovation results report.
  2. Stage 2 (Mar 1-5): 15-minute teaching innovation design presentation.
  3. Stage 3 (Mar 13-15): Classroom teaching video review, with winners determined by combined scores across all three stages.
- **Awards**: First, second, and third prizes; winners will be recommended for the Shandong Provincial Teachers' Teaching Innovation Competition.
- **Deadlines**: Recommendation summary table due Jan 15, 12:00; Stage 1 materials due Jan 25, 12:00; Classroom videos due Mar 12, 17:00. Participants must join QQ group 892590352.
- **Contact**: Liu Xuhua (刘旭华), phone 0532-86983202, email LXH2014@upc.edu.cn.

The page also includes the College of Pipeline and Civil Engineering's website navigation structure, listing its departments (Storage and Transportation Engineering, Civil Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Gas Engineering, Architecture, etc.), faculty lists (professors, associate professors, lecturers), research sections, and contact information (address: No. 66 Changjiang West Road, Huangdao District, Qingdao, Shandong; phone 0532-86981878).

# 关于开展2023-2024-2学期青年教师教学竞赛的通知

[教学管理](https://www.hejuncollege.com/jxgl), [通知公告公示](https://www.hejuncollege.com/jxgl/cxjy)

各学院（部）：

为深入学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神，落实全国教育大会精神和中共中央、国务院《关于全面深化新时代教师队伍建设改革的意见要求》，大力弘扬劳模精神、劳动精神、工匠精神，以教育家精神为引领，进一步加强我校青年教师队伍建设，助力高等教育高质量发展，加快推进教育强国建设，根据工作安排，我校举办青年教师教学竞赛（以下简称“教学竞赛”），现将有关事宜通知如下：

**一、竞赛原则**

本次竞赛由教学设计、课堂教学和教学反思三部分组成。竞赛总分为100 分，教学设计、课堂教学、教学反思三部分分值分别为20 分、75 分、5 分（具体评分细则见附件）。

**（一）教学设计**

教学设计是指以1 个学时为基本单位，对教学活动的设想与安排。主要包括课程名称（注明对应的参赛课程大纲章节）、教学指导思想、内容分析、学情分析、教学目标、教学重难点、教学过程设计等。

选手需准备参赛课程16 个学时的教学设计方案，每个学时的教学设计方案注明对应的参赛课程大纲章节。评委将对整套教学设计方案进行打分。

**（二）课堂教学**

课堂教学规定时间为20 分钟。评委主要从教学内容、教学组织、教学语言与教态、教学特色四个方面进行评审。选手需准备参赛课程16 个学时相对应的16 个课堂教学节段的PPT，课堂教学内容要与提交的教学设计内容对应、一致。

**（三）教学反思**

参赛选手结束课堂教学环节后，进入指定教室，结合本节段课堂教学实际，从教学理念、教学方法和教学过程三方面着手，在20 分钟内完成对本讲课节段的教学反思书面材料（300 字以内）。要求思路清晰、观点明确、联系实际，做到有感而发。

**（四）计分方法**

评委评分实行实名制，选手的每部分得分为去掉一个最高分和一个最低分后的平均分，总得分为三部分得分之和。

**二、竞赛学科和参赛对象**

**（一）竞赛学科。**竞赛设立四个组别，分别为文科、理科、工科和思想政治课专项。

**（二）参赛对象**。我校从事教育教学工作的40周岁（含）以下青年教师（1983年8月31日后出生），近一学年持续从事一线教学工作。

**三、竞赛实施**

初赛和决赛。初赛由各学院（部）自行组织，每个学院（部）初赛至少遴选**2-3****人**参加校级决赛。初赛要有方案、有计划、有总结、有报道；决赛由学校教学服务中心组织。

**四、竞赛时间**

初赛在5月中旬完成，决赛在5月底完成。

**五、奖项设置**

按照参赛人数的10%、20%、30%的比例分设一、二、三等奖，颁发获奖证书及奖金。对于本次获奖教师将优先推荐参加第六届江西省高校青年教师教学竞赛。

args.summary:
This webpage is from the official website of Hejun Vocational College (和君职业学院, HejunCollege). The main content is an official notice titled "关于开展2023-2024-2学期青年教师教学竞赛的通知" (Notice on Conducting the 2023-2024 Semester 2 Young Teacher Teaching Competition), issued by the Teaching Service Center (教学服务中心) on April 26, 2024, targeting all colleges/departments.

KEY DETAILS OF THE COMPETITION:

1. **Competition Structure & Scoring**: The competition consists of three parts totaling 100 points: Teaching Design (教学设计, 20 points), Classroom Teaching (课堂教学, 75 points), and Teaching Reflection (教学反思, 5 points). Each part's score is calculated by removing the highest and lowest scores and averaging the rest (real-name scoring system).

2. **Teaching Design**: Competitors must prepare teaching design plans for 16 class hours of their course (each noting the corresponding course syllabus section), covering course name, teaching philosophy, content analysis, student analysis, teaching goals, key points, and teaching process design. The entire set is scored by judges.

3. **Classroom Teaching**: Limited to 20 minutes. Judged on teaching content, organization, language/demeanor, and teaching characteristics. Competitors must prepare 16 PPTs corresponding to the 16 class-hour teaching segments.

4. **Teaching Reflection**: After the classroom session, competitors write a reflection (within 300 words) in 20 minutes, addressing teaching philosophy, methods, and process.

5. **Categories & Eligibility**: Four groups: Liberal Arts (文科), Science (理科), Engineering (工科), and Ideological-Political Course (思想政治课专项). Eligible participants are teachers aged 40 and below (born after August 31, 1983) who have been continuously teaching for the past academic year.

6. **Implementation**: Preliminary rounds organized by each college (each must select at least 2-3 candidates for the school-level finals); finals organized by the Teaching Service Center. Preliminary rounds in mid-May; finals by end of May.

7. **Awards**: First, second, and third prizes are awarded according to 10%, 20%, and 30% of participants, with certificates and bonuses. Winners will be prioritized for recommendation to the 6th Jiangxi Provincial College Young Teacher Teaching Competition.

The page also includes the college's full website navigation structure (covering school overview, admissions/employment, teaching management, academic research, student affairs, Party building, campus services, and campus scenery) and a link to the official scoring rubric document. The next article is about foreign teachers conducting cultural exchange at Baie Township Central Primary School (the college is located in Jiangxi's Huichang area).

args.summary:
This is an official notice from Wuyi University (五邑大学) announcing the school-level selection competition for the 8th National College Young Teachers Teaching Competition (第八届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛校级选拔赛), dated April 1, 2026.

**Eligibility:** Teachers aged 40 or under (born after August 31, 1985), full-time and in-service, who have continuously taught frontline courses for the past 3 academic years (2023–2026), with information registered in the National Teacher Management Information System. Ideological and political theory course teachers must also register in the university's ideological and political theory teacher information database. Applicants must comply with national laws, uphold Party education policies, practice socialist core values, and possess good political, ideological, and teacher ethics.

**Competition Content (following provincial competition format):** Five groups - Liberal Arts (文科), Science (理科), Engineering (工科), Medicine (医科), and Ideological and Political Theory Special (思想政治理论课专项). Upholding the concept of "teaching one course well," the competition comprises three parts:
1. Teaching Design (教学设计): Prepare course syllabus and 8 class-hours of teaching design plans (including course name, teaching guiding ideology, content analysis, learner analysis, teaching objectives, key/difficult points, and teaching process design).
2. Classroom Teaching (课堂教学): 20-minute "teacher-less teaching" (无生教学) on-site presentation, with 8 PPT teaching segments corresponding to the 8 class-hours. Evaluated on teaching content, organization, language and demeanor, and teaching characteristics.
3. Teaching Reflection (教学反思): 3-minute oral reflection addressing teaching philosophy, methods, and process.

**Schedule:**
- College-level selection (院级选拔赛): Each college forms a working group (college leaders, teaching supervisors, department heads) to organize eligible teachers, recommending 3-5 outstanding participants. Must complete by April 20.
- School-level competition (校级比赛): Includes network review (scoring - syllabus: 20 points, teaching design: 20 points, segment PPT: 10 points, classroom recorded video: 50 points) and on-site finals (20-minute classroom teaching: 95 points; 3-minute oral reflection: 5 points, with 2-minute preparation).

**Materials Required from Participating Teachers:** Recommendation form, course syllabus, 8 teaching segment catalog (PDF), 8 class-hour teaching design plans (PDF), 8 classroom teaching segment PPTs (16:9, 1600x900 resolution, with embedded audio/video and non-system fonts), classroom teaching recorded video with corresponding teaching design. Materials (except the recommendation form) must NOT reveal the teacher's name or school/college information.

**Deadline:** All materials must be submitted by April 20, 2026 at 17:00, both in paper and electronic (USB drive) formats, to the Teacher Teaching Development Center (南主楼628). Materials named as: College + Name + Group + Material Name.

**Additional Requirements:** Competition participation must be included in annual and performance assessments; school-level results and provincial competition selection outcomes will factor into teacher assessments, title evaluation, and position hiring. Teachers are responsible for any intellectual property violations. Jointly organized by the Teacher Teaching Development Center, Labor Union (工会), and Academic Affairs Office (教务处).

**Contacts:** Teacher Teaching Development Center - Yang Huimin (杨慧敏), phone 3296541 (6541); Academic Affairs Office - Wang Minrong (王敏容), phone 3296693 (6693).

**Attachments (7):** Player recommendation form, teaching segment selection method, segment catalog template, classroom video recording standards, recommended player summary table, Guangdong 7th College Young Teacher Teaching Competition scoring standards, and advance notice of the Guangdong 7th young teacher teaching competition.

University address: Wuyi University, No. 99 Yingbin Avenue, Pengjiang District, Jiangmen City, Guangdong Province, postal code 529020. Emails: jsgzb@wyu.edu.cn (Party Committee Teacher Work Department), wyuhr@wyu.edu.cn (Human Resources Management Office).

This is an official notice (No. 1) from a university's Teacher Development Center announcing the 2026 Young Teachers' Teaching Competition, dated April 29, 2026, to prepare for the group's 11th university young teachers' teaching competition.

**Purpose**: To implement the spirit of the 20th Party Congress and Xi Jinping's important discourse on education, strengthen young teachers' teaching fundamentals, promote curriculum ideological and political education, and adapt to education digital transformation.

**Key Details:**
- **Competition Time**: Early June 2026 (specific time/place to be announced)
- **Participants**: Full-time young teachers who joined within the past three years and have had no teaching accidents in the past year
- **Category Groups (Seven)**: Humanities & Social Sciences (economics, law, education, literature, management, art), Science & Engineering (science, engineering, agriculture, medicine), Basic Courses (college math, physics, Chinese, PE, ideological/political courses, mental health), Foreign Languages (English, business English, Japanese, Korean, French), Practice Teaching (sports skills, dance, lab teaching, internships)
- **Scoring**: Total 100 points—Teaching Design (20%), Classroom Teaching (70%), Teaching Feedback (10%)

**Competition Components:**
1. **Teaching Design (20 pts)**: Submit teaching materials including syllabus (with assessment methods), complete lesson plan, complete PPT, and teaching design compilation manual—all in electronic and/or paper forms. Must include "Curriculum Ideological and Political Education Implementation Statement" and "Teaching Digitalization Application Statement."
2. **Classroom Teaching (70 pts)**: 25 minutes total (20 min teaching + 5 min expert questioning). Teachers prepare 3 teaching segments; the specific segment is drawn by lottery on site. Evaluated on teaching content, organization, teaching quality, and question response, plus integration of ideological-political elements.
3. **Teaching Feedback (10 pts)**: Written within 20 minutes after teaching, reflecting on judges' questions, personal insights, how students were guided/engaged, and improvement directions.

**Process**: Teachers draw their teaching segment on competition day; after classroom teaching, complete feedback within 20 minutes for the secretary; scores are compiled and announced after competition.

**Awards**: First, second, and third prizes with certificates and bonuses; winners get priority consideration in annual evaluation and title/promotion reviews.

**Deadline**: Teaching units must submit the 2026 Young Teachers' Teaching Competition Summary Table by Monday May 11, 2026, 16:00 (electronic version via email, paper version to academic affairs office).

**Contact**: Zhang Xue, Administrative Building Room 210, Phone: 59339147, Email: 328538881@qq.com

This document outlines the implementation plan for the 4th Jiangsu Province Young University Teacher Teaching Competition (第四届江苏省高校青年教师教学竞赛). 

**Competition Groups:** The competition is divided into five groups: Humanities (文科 - philosophy, economics, law, education, literature, history, management, arts), Sciences (理科 - science), Engineering (工科 - engineering, agriculture), Ideological and Political Courses (思想政治课), and Medicine (医学).

**Competition Content and Format:** Based on the concept of "delivering one good lesson," the competition consists of three parts scored on a 100-point scale: Teaching Design (20 points), Classroom Teaching (75 points), and Teaching Reflection (5 points).

1. **Teaching Design (20 pts):** Competitors must prepare teaching design plans and corresponding classroom PPTs for 20 teaching segments (each representing 20 minutes of classroom content).
2. **Classroom Teaching (75 pts):** 20-minute lessons taught in Mandarin, evaluated on teaching content (30 pts), teaching organization (30 pts), language and demeanor (10 pts), and teaching features (5 pts). Teaching aids such as models, charts, and pointer devices are permitted.
3. **Teaching Reflection (5 pts):** Within 45 minutes after classroom teaching, competitors must complete a written reflection (under 500 characters) on teaching philosophy, methods, and process. No reference materials are allowed.

**Scoring:** Judges score on a real-name basis; one highest and one lowest score are dropped, and results are announced after each day's competition.

**Competition Rules:** Courses must carry at least 2 credits. Contestant order is determined by drawing lots, and specific teaching segments are also drawn on competition day. Classroom sessions generally exclude students unless approved by the organizing committee.

**Team Organization and Registration:** Each prefecture-level education union and undergraduate university union may field one team. Registration materials include ID copies, recommendation forms, and summary tables. Competition materials require both electronic versions (CD-ROM with course catalog, 20 teaching designs, and 20 PPTs in 4:3 PowerPoint 97-2003 format) and 8 bound paper copies (cover page, syllabus, segment catalog, designs, and printed PPTs with max 6 slides per page). Materials must not contain contestant names/schools except on the outer cover. The document includes scoring rubrics for all three components and an example of a 20-segment course catalog.

### 关于举办2025年历史学院青年教师教学竞赛的通知

来源：浙江大学历史学院办公网 发布时间：2025-12-02 作者： 阅读数数：56

根据《关于举办第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛的通知》（总工办发〔2024〕11号）、《关于开展第十四届浙江省高校青年教师教学竞赛的通知》（浙教工〔2025〕8号）和《浙江大学青年教师教学竞赛实施办法》（浙大发本〔2017〕123号）要求，启动2025年历史学院青年教师教学竞赛，定于10月17日（周五）举行，现将有关事项通知如下：

一、竞赛宗旨

围绕立德树人根本任务，以加强师德师风建设、锤炼教学基本功为着力点，充分发挥教学竞赛在提高教师队伍素质中的示范引领作用，进一步激发青年教师更新教育理念和掌握现代教学方法的热情，努力造就一支有理想信念、有道德情操、有扎实学识、有仁爱之心的高素质、专业化教师队伍，推动学校一流本科教育事业持续发展。

二、竞赛原则

坚持公开、公平、公正；坚持广泛参与、层层发动；坚持注重教学基本功和实际应用能力；坚持程序严谨、规范。

三、参赛对象

1.在职教师，年龄原则在40周岁以下。(1985 年8 月 31 日后出生）。

2.作为主讲教师开设课程1年及以上，且课堂教学质量评价优良，未发生教学事故。

3. 遵守国家宪法和法律，贯彻党的教育方针，自觉践行社会主义核心价值观，具有良好的思想政治素质和师德师风修养，近3学年持续从事一线教学工作。

四、竞赛安排

主要流程和要求如下：

1.由学院组委会负责组织，组委会组建青年教师教学竞赛评选委员会（以下简称评委会），评委会由教学一线教师、教学名师、督导和学生等人员组成。

学院组委会成员如下：

组  长：肖如平、鲍永军；   副组长：卢军霞、刘寅、王万成；

2.比赛内容以“上好一门课”为竞赛理念，由教学设计、课堂教学和教学反思三部分组成，权重分别为 20%、75%、5%。

（1）教学设计：教学设计是指以1个学时为基本单位，对教学活动的设想与安排。主要包括课程名称（注明对应的参赛课程大纲章节）、教学指导思想、内容分析、学情分析、教学目标、教学重点与难点、教学过程设计等。

教师需准备参赛课程2个学时的教学设计方案，每个学时的教学设计方案注明对应的参赛课程大纲章节。评委将对整套教学设计方案进行打分。

（2）课堂教学：课堂教学规定时间为20分钟。评委主要从教学内容、教学组织、教学语言与教态、教学特色四个方面进行评审。参赛教师需提前准备参赛课程2个学时相对应的2个课堂教学节段的PPT，课堂教学内容要与提交的教学设计内容对应、一致。

（3）教学反思

参赛教师结束课堂教学环节后，进入指定教室，结合现场展示课堂教学节段的课堂教学实际，从教学理念、教学方法和教学过程三方面着手，在45 分钟内完成对本讲课节段的教学反思材料（500 字以内）。要求思路清晰、观点明确、联系实际，做到有感而发。反思室提供电脑，不允许携带任何书面或电子等形式的资料。

（4）计分方法

评委评分实行实名制，教学设计、课堂教学、教学反思三部分具体评分细则附后（参见附件1）。成绩评定采用百分制，参赛教师三个部分的得分相加为最终得分。

（4）注意事项

①教师参赛课程的实际学分要求不得少于2个学分（含2个学分）；

②教师在教学设计、课堂教学、教学反思中提交的材料不得出现姓名、学院（系）等任何与个人相关的信息；

args.summary:
This webpage is from Zhejiang University School of History (浙江大学历史学院) and announces the 2025 Young Faculty Teaching Competition (青年教师教学竞赛). The competition is scheduled for Friday, October 17, 2025, and was announced on December 2, 2025 (with the notice itself dated October 11, 2025).

Key details of the competition:
- **Purpose**: To strengthen teacher ethics, hone basic teaching skills, encourage young teachers to update educational concepts and master modern teaching methods, and build a high-quality professional teaching team to support first-class undergraduate education.
- **Principles**: Openness, fairness, and justice; broad participation; focus on teaching fundamentals and practical application; rigorous and standardized procedures.
- **Eligibility**: In-service teachers under age 40 (born after August 31, 1985); at least 1 year of teaching as lead instructor with good teaching quality evaluations and no teaching accidents; good ideological/political qualities with 3+ years of continuous frontline teaching.
- **Competition structure**: Scored on three components - instructional design (20%), classroom teaching (75%), and teaching reflection (5%). Teachers prepare 2 class-hour instructional designs and 2 corresponding classroom teaching PPT segments. Classroom teaching is 20 minutes. Teaching reflection (under 500 words) must be completed within 45 minutes in a designated room with no reference materials allowed.
- **Scoring**: Anonymous grading system; no personal information may appear in submitted materials. One classroom teaching segment is determined by lottery before the final.
- **Awards**: Rewards limited to no more than one-third of participants. First prize 800 yuan, second prize 500 yuan, third prize 300 yuan. Additional rewards for winners at the university level per the School's honor reward measures.
- **Application**: Submission deadline October 15, 2025, via electronic application form to f020081@zju.edu.cn. Contacts: 符芳 and 高晖, phone 88208646 and 88273199.

The notice includes attachments (evaluation criteria document and teacher application form as .docx files). The competition organizing committee is led by 肖如平 and 鲍永军 as chairs, with 卢军霞, 刘寅, and 王万成 as vice-chairs. The notice references several guiding documents including the 7th National College Young Teacher Teaching Competition notice and Zhejiang Province's 14th provincial competition notice.

The page also includes standard school navigation and contact information: email xuhb@zju.edu.cn, phone 0571-88273301, address in Zijingang Campus, Hangzhou, Zhejiang (成均苑4幢).

来源：中国高等教育学会 作者：中国高等教育培训中心 发布时间：2023-11-16

**各省、自治区、直辖市高等教育学会，行业高等教育学会，各分支机构，各赛区牵头单位，有关高校：**

为进一步推进教育强国建设与高等教育高质量发展，落实立德树人根本任务，大力弘扬教育家精神，助力高校课程思政建设和新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科建设，推动信息技术与高等教育教学创新发展，提高产教协同育人成效，提升高校教师教书育人能力和高校人才自主培养质量，打造高校教学改革的风向标，中国高等教育学会定于2023年11月启动第四届全国高校教师教学创新大赛（以下简称大赛）。现将有关事项通知如下：

**一、举办单位**

指导单位：教育部高等教育司

主办单位：中国高等教育学会

承办单位：电子科技大学、复旦大学、北京理工大学、南京大学、浙江大学、西安交通大学、北京世纪超星信息技术发展有限责任公司

**二、大赛主题**

推动教学创新  培养一流人才

**三、大赛目标**

紧扣建设高质量教育体系主题，深入推动高等教育教学改革，有效助力“四新”建设；充分发挥大赛的示范引领作用，全面推进课程思政建设，精心打造高校教师教学创新与交流的标杆。

**四、大赛内容**

大赛内容包括课堂教学实录视频、教学创新成果报告（课程思政组为课程思政创新报告）、教学设计创新汇报。

**五、参赛对象**

全国普通本科高等学校（含军队院校）在职教师，其中主讲教师近5年对所参赛的本科课程讲授2轮及以上。以个人或团队形式参赛均可，若以团队形式参赛，团队成员包括1名主讲教师和不超过3名团队教师。已获得前三届大赛全国赛一等奖的主讲教师不能再次参赛。

**六、大赛实施**

大赛采用校赛、省（自治区、直辖市、新疆生产建设兵团）赛（以下简称省赛）、全国赛三级赛制。校赛、省赛由各赛区负责组织实施。

（一）校赛

各高校根据相应省赛方案，保质保量按时完成校内比赛，选拔参加省赛的教师（团队）。

（二）省赛

各赛区牵头单位负责组织赛区内高校教师省赛的开展，并于2024年5月7日前在大赛官网上传全国赛参赛教师（团队）名单，其中，各赛区推荐参加全国赛的主讲教师，正高组总人数不少于总人数的1/3。

（三）全国赛

全国赛具体事项另行通知。

**七、组织机构**

大赛设组织委员会、专家委员会、纪律与监督委员会和仲裁委员会。

**八、大赛官网**

大赛网址：[nticct.cahe.edu.cn](http://nticct.cahe.edu.cn)

开放时间：2023年11月17日

**九、其他事项**

（一）各高校、赛区要认真做好大赛组织与推荐工作，严格审查参赛教师（团队）资格。

（二）参赛教师（团队）应保证参赛材料的原创性，不得抄袭、剽窃他人作品，如产生侵权行为或涉及知识产权纠纷，由参赛教师（团队）及所在高校自行承担相应责任。

This webpage (from the China Higher Education Training Center, chetc.cahe.edu.cn, a subsidiary of the China Association of Higher Education) announces the 4th National College Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition (全国高校教师教学创新大赛).

Key details:
- **Announcement date**: November 16, 2023; official launch of the competition by the China Association of Higher Education in November 2023.
- **Organizers**: Guided by the Ministry of Education's Higher Education Department; hosted by the China Association of Higher Education; co-organized by University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Fudan University, Beijing Institute of Technology, Nanjing University, Zhejiang University, Xi'an Jiaotong University, and Beijing Century Chaoxing Information Technology Development Co., Ltd.
- **Theme**: "Promoting Teaching Innovation, Cultivating Top-Notch Talents" (推动教学创新 培养一流人才).
- **Goals**: Deepen higher education teaching reform, support the "Four New" (four-new) construction (new engineering, medicine, agriculture, liberal arts), advance curriculum ideological-political education, and create a benchmark for college teaching innovation.
- **Competition content**: Includes classroom teaching video recordings, teaching innovation achievement reports (curriculum ideological-political education innovation reports for that category), and teaching design innovation presentations.
- **Participants**: In-service teachers at Chinese regular undergraduate universities (including military academies) who have taught the participating undergraduate course 2 or more times in the past 5 years. Entry can be individual or team (1 lead teacher + up to 3 team teachers). Previous first-prize winners in the national round cannot participate again.
- **Competition structure**: Three levels - institutional (校赛), provincial (省赛), and national (全国赛). Provincial rounds must upload national participants by May 7, 2024; senior professional title (正高) participants must be no less than 1/3 of the total recommended for national competition.
- **Organizational bodies**: Organizing committee, expert committee, discipline and supervision committee, and arbitration committee.
- **Competition website**: nticct.cahe.edu.cn (opened November 17, 2023).
- **Requirements**: Schools must strictly review participant eligibility; materials must be original (no plagiarism); submitted materials and live presentation materials must not reveal participant names, institutions, or department identities.
- **Contacts**: Listed for University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Beijing Century Chaoxing, and the China Association of Higher Education.
- An attachment PDF of the competition implementation plan is provided.

args.summary: 第四届全国高校教师教学创新大赛是由教育部高等教育司指导、中国高等教育学会主办的全国性高校教师教学竞赛，于2024年举办，主题为"推动教学创新、培养一流人才"。该赛事自2020年起每年举办一次，旨在推动高等教育教学改革、引导高校教师潜心教书育人。赛事于2023年12月15日在电子科技大学启动，吸引全国32个赛区1249所高校共104686名教师参加校赛，25761名教师参加省（区、市）赛，覆盖全部学科门类，共有483门课程的1779位教师参加现场赛，参与规模居历届之首。相比第三届，校赛规模增长25.8%，省赛规模增长11.6%。本届比赛首次吸引27所军队院校和国家开放大学体系内17所学校教师参赛。全国赛于2024年7月27-31日在成都（电子科技大学举行主体赛事）举办，覆盖课程思政、新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科、基础课程等赛道，共评选出一等奖73项、二等奖170项、三等奖240项，21个单位获优秀组织奖。产教融合赛道全国赛于2024年11月11-14日在重庆邮电大学举行，评选出一等奖12项、二等奖28项、三等奖41项。赛事期间举办了拔尖创新人才自主培养、教育数字化创新发展等五场学术活动，以及高校教师课堂教学创新与产教融合改革论坛和全国高校教师教学创新发展风采展。中国高等教育学会会长杜玉波作题为《教育强国建设背景下高等教育高质量发展》的专题报告。比赛期间，重庆共获一等奖2项、二等奖5项、三等奖4项；贵州大学获国赛一等奖2项、二等奖2项；北京物资学院教授张旭凤获一等奖；黑龙江青年教师葛坤获基础课程赛道一等奖。

# [关于举办第四届全国高校教师教学创新大赛校赛的通知](https://www.teach.ustc.edu.cn/notice/notice-teaching/17333.html)

2023-12-15 14:58 | 1609 views | https://www.teach.ustc.edu.cn/notice/notice-teaching/17333.html

为推动教学创新，培养一流人才，**中国高等教育学会**启动第四届全国高校教师教学创新大赛，**安徽省教育厅**负责组织第四届全国高校教师教学创新大赛安徽省赛。根据《安徽省教育厅关于举办第四届全国高校教师教学创新大赛安徽赛区比赛的通知》（皖教秘高〔2023〕159号）要求，**我校将举办第四届高校教师教学创新大赛校赛**。

**大赛定位：**教学创新大赛是经教育部批准，纳入《教育部直属单位三评一竞赛保留项目清单》的赛项之一，是目前项目清单中唯一一项高校教师教学竞赛活动。

**参赛对象：**参赛对象为本校在职或正式聘用教师，近五年对所参赛的本科课程讲授2轮及以上的教师。以个人或团队形式报名，鼓励以团队形式参赛，团队成员包括1名主讲教师和不超过3名团队教师。

**大赛机制：**大赛分校赛、省赛、全国赛三级赛制，分赛道进行比赛，具体赛事信息见附件1、2。

### 校赛安排：

#### （1）组织动员

请各学院、各课程组以大赛为契机，认真总结课程建设成果，凝练课程教学理念与目标、总结教学创新举措、创新成效，发挥成果辐射作用，组织动员本院、本课程组老师积极参赛。根据省赛要求，推荐参赛队伍中正高组主讲教师不少于1/3，请着力动员正高级教师报名参赛。

#### （2）教师申报

请报名参赛的老师填写准备申报材料，包括申报书（附件3）、教学创新成果报告（内容要求见附件2）、教学创新成果支撑材料目录（附件4）。**其中教学创新成果报告包括摘要、正文，字数4000字左右为宜。**请于12月27日前将三份报名材料反馈至教务处杜筱婧老师邮箱（dxj01@ustc.edu.cn），邮件主题请写明“第四届教创赛校赛参赛材料提交”，三份材料请以“姓名+所在院级单位+‘申报书/创新成果报告/支撑材料目录’”命名。并于12月27日将完成签章的申报书纸质版提交至老图书馆225室杨阳老师处。

#### （3）校赛评奖与省赛推荐

教务处教师教学发展中心将邀请校内外专家对申报材料进行线上评审，并于2024年1月6日组织参赛教师进行教学设计创新汇报。汇报具体安排另行通知，请参赛教师提前做好工作安排，准时参加现场汇报。

根据申报材料评审得分（满分20分）和现场汇报得分（满分40分），综合评定校赛获奖教师（团队）。在省赛名额分配后，根据省赛要求，择优推荐校赛获奖老师参加省赛。

This is the official website of the Academic Affairs Office (教务处) of the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC, 中国科学技术大学), containing navigation links for students and faculty alongside a specific notice about the 4th National University Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition (第四届全国高校教师教学创新大赛).

**Key Website Resources:**
- Learning resources: department/major info, training programs (培养方案), undergraduate study guide, academic advising, teaching secretary contacts, comprehensive quality course catalog
- Systems: Comprehensive Academic Affairs System (综合教务系统, jw.ustc.edu.cn), teaching assistant management system, classroom application, equipment repair, teacher development center
- Information queries: departments/majors, course schedule, execution plans, course offerings across the university, exam queries, staff contacts, teaching building contacts and diagrams
- Regulations: teaching management documents, workflow guides, system operation manuals, undergraduate teaching management files, teacher handbook
- Contact: Address - No. 96 Jinzhai Road, Hefei, Anhui (老图书馆2楼/教二楼7楼); Hotline: 0551-63602251; Email: jwc@ustc.edu.cn

**Main Notice: 4th National University Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition School-level Competition (校赛)**

- **Background:** Initiated by the Chinese Association of Higher Education (中国高等教育学会); Anhui Provincial Education Department organizes the provincial competition per document 皖教秘高〔2023〕159号. USTC will host its school-level competition (校赛).

args.summary:
This is an official notice from Yangtze University's Undergraduate College (本科生院) dated December 4, 2023, announcing the "Fourth Yangtze University Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition" (长江大学第四届教师教学创新大赛), scheduled for January 2024. The competition is organized in accordance with notices from the China Association of Higher Education (高学会〔2023〕108号) and the Hubei Provincial Association of Higher Education.

**Competition Goals and Theme:** The event aims to promote high-quality higher education reform, support the "Four New" (四新) constructions (new engineering, medicine, agriculture, liberal arts), advance curriculum ideology and politics (课程思政) construction, and promote information technology integration in teaching. The theme is "推动教学创新 培养一流人才" (Promote Teaching Innovation, Cultivate First-Class Talent).

**Eligibility and Grouping:** All Yangtze University in-service teachers are eligible, with the requirement that the lead teacher has taught the undergraduate course for at least 2 rounds in the past 5 years. Participation can be individual or in teams (1 lead teacher + up to 3 team members). The competition has 7 major groups based on "Four New" construction, basic courses, curriculum ideology/politics, and industry-education integration. Groups 1-6 are divided by professional title (senior, associate senior, intermediate and below) into 18 subgroups: New Engineering (Group 1), New Medicine (Group 2), New Agriculture (Group 3), New Liberal Arts (Group 4), Basic Courses (Group 5), and Curriculum Ideology & Politics (Group 6). Group 7 (Industry-Education Integration) has separately defined quotas.

Each college may recommend 3-4 teachers who must not be in the same group. The school recommends 9 participants for the provincial competition, with at least 3 from the senior title group and at least 1 from the curriculum ideology/politics group. Teachers in emerging fields (AI, integrated circuits, quantum technology, energy storage, smart manufacturing, digital economy, biological breeding, smart agriculture, intelligent medical engineering, international communication) and specific courses (farm education, general medicine, traditional Chinese medicine classics, "Understanding Contemporary China") are encouraged to apply.

**Competition Process:** The competition has college-level (院赛) and school-level (校赛) stages. The school stage includes material review (60 points) and on-site review (40 points). Material review requires submission of application forms, course syllabi, and teaching innovation achievement reports (or curriculum ideology/politics innovation reports). The on-site review consists of a 15-minute teaching design innovation presentation followed by 10 minutes of expert Q&A.

**Materials and Submission:** Four electronic materials must be submitted by December 20, 2023, to email 34463188@qq.com, with folder naming: College+Name+Group: (1) Application form (5 points), (2) Course teaching syllabus (15 points), (3) Teaching innovation achievement report or curriculum ideology/politics innovation report (~4000 words, 40 points), and (4) Teaching innovation design presentation (40 points, on-site, timing announced separately).

**Other Matters:** Materials must be original with no plagiarism or infringement. Provincial competition awards will count toward college development indicator rewards. Contact: Teacher Zhou, East Campus Undergraduate College Office 216, phone 0716-8060259. Four attachments are provided: provincial scoring standards, application form, course syllabus template, and supporting materials catalog.

args.summary:
This webpage from Xi'an Siyuan University (西安思源学院) Personnel Office, under the "Teacher Ethics and Professional Conduct" (师德师风) section, announces the upcoming live broadcast of the 7th National College Young Teachers' Teaching Competition Finals (第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛决赛).

The finals will be held in Shanghai from August 26-30, 2024. The competition is co-hosted by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and the Ministry of Education, with organization by the China Education, Science, Culture, Health and Sports Union and the Ministry of Education's Teacher Work Division, and co-organized by the Shanghai Education Union and Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

Live broadcasts will be available through CCTV/China National Radio (央广网), the "All-China Federation of Trade Unions" WeChat video channel, the Workers' Daily client, and the "Shanghai Jiao Tong University Union" WeChat public account.

The finals consist of five competition groups:
1. Liberal Arts (philosophy, economics, law, education, literature, history, management, arts)
2. Natural Sciences (science)
3. Engineering (engineering, agriculture)
4. Medical Sciences (medicine)
5. Ideological and Political Theory Courses (special category)

Award structure:
- Individual Awards: Each group awards 5 first prizes, 10 second prizes, and several third prizes. Award winners receive trophies and certificates, gain recognition in teacher title evaluations, and receive preferences in related honors and commendations. Winners of the first place in each group who meet eligibility requirements may apply for the "National May 1st Labor Medal" per All-China Federation of Trade Unions regulations.
- Collective Awards: Outstanding Organization Awards are given to units demonstrating extensive activity coverage, high teacher participation, and excellent organizational work.

Live broadcast times:
- Wednesday, August 28: 8:30-12:00 and 14:00-17:30
- Thursday, August 29: 8:30-12:00 and 14:00-17:30

### 综合新闻

我校教师在第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛决赛中取得佳绩

# 

8月26至30日，由中华全国总工会、教育部联合主办，中国教科文卫体工会、教育部教师工作司联合承办的第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛决赛在上海交通大学成功举办。经过激烈角逐、我校物理科学与技术学院李东、公共政策与管理学院宋丁博男分别夺得理科组一等奖、文科组二等奖，总成绩位居全国高校第三。

![](/__local/3/6B/3B/CC0AB78EC9AB3A60C3E02F80D78_C6F0041B_30D87.jpg "mtxx01.jpg")

![](/__local/3/6B/3B/CC0AB78EC9AB3A60C3E02F80D78_C6F0041B_30D87.jpg "mtxx01.jpg")

![](/__local/8/2A/EC/5F2CD9CB2987D0C2259776DC1D0_207577A3_344B8.jpg "mtxx02.jpg")

![](/__local/8/2A/EC/5F2CD9CB2987D0C2259776DC1D0_207577A3_344B8.jpg "mtxx02.jpg")

全国高校青年教师教学竞赛突出强调立德树人根本宗旨，以弘扬教育家精神为引领，始终坚持“上好一门课”理念，充分发挥教学竞赛在提高教师队伍素质中的示范引领作用。据统计，全国2028所高校的30余万名青年教师参与了各层级的竞赛。决赛分成文科组、理科组、工科组、医科组、思想政治课专项组五个组别，每个组别每个省（区、市）只有一位选手参赛，最终来自31个省（区、市）和新疆生产建设兵团130所学校的159名选手脱颖而出，进入全国决赛，经过最终比拼，每个组别前五名获全国一等奖、每个组别六至十五名获全国二等奖。

![](/__local/D/36/8C/C67D605E118B184AABBE2F1F67B_5A459CDB_44CBF.jpg "mtxx03.jpg")

![](/__local/D/36/8C/C67D605E118B184AABBE2F1F67B_5A459CDB_44CBF.jpg "mtxx03.jpg")

自大赛启动以来，校领导高度重视，多次亲临现场给予鼓励和指导。我校工会、教务部及参赛教师所在学院等多部门紧密配合，科学谋划，邀请了校内外经验丰富的专家组成辅导团队，对参赛教师在课程内容、教学设计、课件制作、教学反思及课堂讲授等环节进行了全方位、多轮次的精细指导。两位参赛教师经过大半年的艰苦备战和精心准备，最终载誉归来，展示了我校青年教师的风采，为学校赢得了荣誉，再一次取得了此项赛事一等奖，创我校参赛人数和获奖等级的新高。

本次青教赛的优异成绩，充分彰显了“总师育人文化”在教学实践中的显著成效。竞赛中，“总师育人文化”倡导的全面素质培养、教学创新和对学生的深切关怀得到了生动体现。这一荣誉不仅是对我校青年教师卓越教学能力的高度认可，更是对“总师育人文化”在实际教学中成功实施的有力证明。

![](/__local/0/BF/3C/54C4D163C20FFFD612FD9EFF019_9650C386_502CB.jpg "mtxx04.jpg")

![](/__local/0/BF/3C/54C4D163C20FFFD612FD9EFF019_9650C386_502CB.jpg "mtxx04.jpg")

下一步，学校将持续引导广大青年教师进一步加强师德师风建设，夯实教学基本功，专注教书育人，通过深入践行“总师育人文化”，将“低调务实、兼收并蓄，厚积薄发、为国铸剑”的总师特质内涵融入人才培养的全过程，着力培养学生具备“专业精、系统强、重实践、能担当”的“总师”雏形特质，续写新时代卓越人才培养的“西工大现象”，为实现“天下工大、世界三航”的远景目标作出新贡献。

![](/__local/C/C3/81/537F84CBE29841E7EA387805341_A2EEF4F6_41EFF.jpg "mtxx05.jpg")

![](/__local/C/C3/81/537F84CBE29841E7EA387805341_A2EEF4F6_41EFF.jpg "mtxx05.jpg")

args.summary:
This is a news article from a university website (likely Northwestern Polytechnical University / 西北工业大学) reporting on faculty achievements at the 7th National College Young Teachers Teaching Competition final held in Shanghai from August 26-30.

Key facts:
- The competition was co-hosted by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and the Ministry of Education, and organized by China's Education, Science, Culture, Health and Sports Union and the Ministry of Education's Teacher Work Department.
- The final competition took place at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
- Li Dong from the School of Physical Science and Technology won first prize (一等奖) in the science group, and Song Dingbonan from the School of Public Policy and Management won second prize (二等奖) in the liberal arts group.
- The university's overall ranking placed third among all universities nationwide.
- Statistics: 2,028 universities and more than 300,000 young teachers participated in various levels of the competition.
- The finals were divided into five categories: liberal arts, science, engineering, medicine, and ideological/political theory special group. Each province could send only one contestant per category.
- A total of 159 contestants from 130 schools across 31 provinces/autonomous regions/municipalities and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps advanced to the national finals.
- In the finals, the top 5 in each category won first prize, and ranks 6-15 won second prize.
- The university's leadership gave high priority to the competition, and the union, academic affairs department, and colleges cooperated with expert coaching teams providing comprehensive, multi-round guidance on course content, instructional design, courseware creation, teaching reflection, and classroom delivery.
- The two teachers prepared for over half a year.
- This achievement set new records for the university in both number of participants and award levels.
- The results were attributed to the "总师育人文化" (Chief Engineer Cultivation Culture), which emphasizes comprehensive quality development, teaching innovation, and deep care for students.
- The school plans to continue integrating the "总师" culture into teaching, cultivating students with "professional precision, strong systems thinking, practical emphasis, and responsibility" traits, continuing the "Northwestern Polytechnical University phenomenon" of cultivating exceptional talents.
- Article credits: text by Tian Jin, Ren Yijiao, Pu Xiaoni; reviewed by Chen Jianjun, Wang Haipeng, Ma Xiping.

### 圆满落幕！第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛总结大会隆重举行

2024-08-30   10892

8月26至30日，由中华全国总工会、教育部联合主办，中国教科文卫体工会、教育部教师工作司联合承办的第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛决赛在上海交通大学成功举办。决赛设置文科、理科、工科、医科、思想政治课专项五个组别。经过激烈角逐，清华大学郭璐、上海交通大学赵维殳、中国农业大学程楠、上海交通大学医学院叶枫、武汉大学徐嘉鸿分获各组别第一名。赛事同步线上直播，点击量突破1000万人次。

8月30日下午，喜迎第四十个教师节暨第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛总结大会在上海交通大学学生中心隆重举行。全国总工会党组成员、经费审查委员会主任蔡安辉，上海交通大学校长、中国科学院院士丁奎岭，上海市政府副秘书长王平，中国教科文卫体工会主席、分党组书记高洁，教育部教师工作司二级巡视员陈武，上海市总工会党组成员、经费审查委员会主任庄勤，上海市教卫工作党委副书记、上海市教育工会主席张艳萍，上海交通大学党委常委、副校长张安胜，校长助理、工会主席于朝阳，中国工程院院士、复旦大学上海医学院资深教授闻玉梅，中国工程院院士、上海交通大学资深教授丁文江，以及本届竞赛的评委，来自31个省区市和新疆生产建设兵团的领队、选手等出席大会。大会由上海交通大学教师刘音、上海教育电视台节目主持人张露嘉主持。

大会在庄严的中华人民共和国国歌声中拉开序幕。

丁奎岭代表上海交通大学向与会领导、嘉宾、老师的到来表示热烈欢迎，向全国总工会、教育部、上海市委市政府的关心支持，及各位专家评委、工作团队、志愿者们的辛勤工作表示敬意和感谢。他表示，今年全国高校青年教师教学竞赛在交大举办，来自全国各地的青年教师、教育专家云集一堂、共襄盛举，合力呈现了一场教书育人的盛会。希望以青教赛为契机，推动“育人神圣”的学风氛围，完善“学在交大”的育人体系，深入践行教育家精神，围绕立德树人根本任务，积极引导青年教师树立“躬耕教坛、强国有我”的志向和抱负。丁奎岭强调，作为一场竞赛，青教赛的比赛刚刚结束；作为教书育人的伟大事业，还需要久久为功、驰而不息。交大也将把青教赛作为师资队伍建设的一项重要路径，既加强师德师风，又锤炼教学基本功，持续提升人才自主培养质量，在服务建设教育强国、科技强国、人才强国中作出新的更大贡献。

王平代表上海市政府对中华全国总工会、教育部、中国教科文卫体工会给予上海的信任与支持表示衷心的感谢，向在本届大赛中取得优异成绩的老师表示诚挚的祝贺，向所有为比赛成功举办做出贡献的工作人员表示由衷的敬意。他表示，全国高校青年教师教学竞赛举办以来，以助力高等教育高质量发展为目标，以加强师德师风建设、锤炼教学基本功为着力点，立讲台、打擂台、搭平台，为高校青年教师插上了腾飞的翅膀，引领带动全国高校教育教学水平的提升。此次全国青教赛在沪举办，为上海高等教育更高质量发展注入了强大的动力。上海将继续营造尊师重教的社会风尚，加大优秀教师宣传推广力度，讲好优秀教师教书育人的故事；着力深化教师评价改革，形成以品德、能力、业绩为主要标准的考核评价导向；强化落实教师减负措施，持续为教师安心、尽心、舒心的从教创造更好的环境。

陈武宣读第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛决赛获奖选手名单。青教赛坚持精神奖励与发展支持相结合。对于所有获奖选手，除颁发奖杯证书以外，教育部将在教师职称评审中体现教育教学实绩，在相关荣誉表彰等方面予以倾斜，全国总工会将对获得各组别第一名且符合条件的选手，按程序申报“全国五一劳动奖章”。

蔡安辉、丁奎岭、王平、高洁、陈武、庄勤、张艳萍、张安胜、于朝阳为获奖选手颁奖。

本届青教赛评委会主任、清华大学行健书院院长李俊峰教授，文科组一等奖第一名清华大学郭璐，理科组一等奖第一名上海交通大学赵维殳，思想政治专项组一等奖第一名武汉大学徐嘉鸿，以及上海青教赛优秀教师代表、上海电力大学杨峰参与圆桌微论坛。

李俊峰表示，这是一场专业性极强的教学盛宴，作为评委也从中收获颇丰，深切感受到了年轻教师们对教学的真挚热爱，并且参赛教师都有较高的学术水平和教学能力，能够将学术研究成果转化为生动、贴近教学实际的教学内容。希望青年教师们要继续保持对教育教学的热情，教好每一门课，教好每一个学生，不断解决教学中遇到的实际问题，勇攀高峰，成为新时代的“大先生”。四位老师分别分享了参赛感受和收获，表示将把这次比赛中学到的知识和经验应用到日常教学中，不断提升自己的教学水平，为教育事业贡献更多的力量。

随后，闻玉梅、丁文江两位院士上台与青年教师分享他们的教书育人故事。闻玉梅院士表示，作为从事教育工作六十余年的老教师，她深感教育事业的崇高与伟大，教育是一个相互学习、教学相长的过程，教师需要以身作则，用自己的言行去影响和感染学生，她还寄语青年教师们要为国家和人民做有益的工作，共同推动社会的进步和发展。

丁文江院士表示，随着教学条件的不断改善，青年教师也拥有更好的资源条件获得成长和发展，这也是时代进步的体现。同时，他还带来了一件仿制西汉古铜镜，并讲述了其来源和背后的故事。他将这件礼物送给获奖青年教师代表，希望他们要将现代科学与中华民族优秀文化相结合，在浩瀚的知识海洋中找到自己的研究方向，结出自己的果实，为中华民族伟大复兴贡献自己的力量。

青年教师代表程楠、叶枫从院士手中接过礼物，表示将把这份荣誉视为新的起点，传承前辈的教育精神，继续在教学和科研的道路上不懈探索，为教育事业贡献青春力量。

上海市教师代表表演诗朗诵《献给第40个教师节》，用真挚的情感和优美的语言，向全体教师表达了崇高的敬意和节日的祝福。

蔡安辉受中华全国总工会党组书记、副主席、书记处第一书记、第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛组委会主任徐留平同志委托，代表全国总工会和竞赛组委会向第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛的获奖选手、单位表示热烈的祝贺，向给予此次竞赛大力支持的教育部、上海市教卫工作党委、上海市教委、上海市总工会和上海交通大学的各位领导，以及为竞赛成功举办付出辛勤劳动的各位评委、监委、志愿者、工作人员和媒体记者们表示诚挚的谢意。蔡安辉强调，各级工会组织特别是教育工会，要全面贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，深入学习贯彻党的二十届三中全会精神，自觉从党和国家事业发展全局的高度，充分认识深化教育综合改革的重要意义，始终将助力教师队伍建设作为重中之重。要强化思想政治引领，引导广大教师坚决拥护改革、积极支持改革、自觉投身改革；要围绕立德树人根本任务，强化教育家精神引领；要聚焦提升教师教书育人能力，切实提升包括青教赛在内的各项工作的质量和水平；要坚持用心用情关心关爱教师，提供更加精准对路的贴心暖心服务，助力广大教师安心从教、热心从教。

大会在合唱《领航》的悠扬歌声中圆满落幕。上海交大教师合唱团用饱满的热情和动听的歌声，表达了对教育事业的热爱和对未来的美好憧憬。

This webpage is from the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) Center for Teaching and Learning Development (CTLD, 教学发展中心), announcing the successful conclusion of the 7th National University Young Teachers' Teaching Competition (青教赛). 

**Key Event Details:**
- The competition finals were held at Shanghai Jiao Tong University from August 26–30, 2024, co-organized by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions (ACFTU) and the Ministry of Education.
- Five competition groups: Liberal Arts, Science, Engineering, Medicine, and Ideological & Political Theory.
- Winners of first place in each group: Guo Lu (Tsinghua University, Liberal Arts), Zhao Weishu (SJTU, Science), Cheng Nan (China Agricultural University, Engineering), Ye Feng (SJTU School of Medicine, Medicine), and Xu Jiahong (Wuhan University, Ideological & Political).
- The competition was live-streamed with over 10 million views.

**Summary Ceremony (August 30, 2024):**
- Held at SJTU Student Center to welcome the 40th Teachers' Day.
- Key attendees included Cai Anhui (ACFTU), SJTU President Ding Kuiling (CAS academician), Shanghai Deputy Secretary Wang Ping, and academicians Wen Yumei and Ding Wenjiang.
- President Ding Kuiling emphasized that SJTU will use the competition to strengthen faculty development and teaching skills.
- First-place winners are eligible to apply for "National May Day Labor Medal."
- Academicians Wen Yumei and Ding Wenjiang shared their teaching experiences; Ding presented a replica of a Han Dynasty bronze mirror to young teacher representatives.
- Cai Anhui called on education unions to support teacher development and educational reform.

**SJTU Results (Best in School History):**
- Zhao Weishu (School of Life Sciences/Science): 1st place in Science group
- Ye Feng (Ruijin Hospital, School of Medicine/Medicine): 1st place in Medicine group
- Wang Xinchang (School of Mechanical Engineering/Engineering): 3rd place in Engineering group (1st prize)

The page also serves as the main navigation portal for the CTLD, listing its various services including teacher training programs, teaching workshops, evaluation services, teaching funds, academic conferences (2016–2026), awards and competitions, and teaching expert database. Recent news items reference summer duty schedules (2026) and the National University Teachers' Teaching Innovation Competition honors (July 2026).

args.key_excerpts: 由中华全国总工会、教育部联合主办的第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛拟定于2024 年 8 月在上海交通大学举办。全国高校青年教师教学竞赛设置文科、理科、工科、医科、思想政 治课专项五个组别，以“上好一门课”为理念。
args.summary:
This webpage is an official notice (document number 高教师培﹝2024﹞008 号) announcing a training seminar titled "第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛备赛指导暨教师教学技能提升专题培训会" (Preparation Guidance for the 7th National Young University Teachers Teaching Competition and Teacher Teaching Skills Enhancement Seminar), held April 26-29, 2024, in Wuhan, Hubei.

**Background**: The 7th National University Young Teachers Teaching Competition (青教赛), jointly organized by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and the Ministry of Education, is scheduled for August 2024 at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The competition has five categories: Liberal Arts (文科), Science (理科), Engineering (工科), Medicine (医科), and Ideological and Political Courses (思政课专项). The competition's philosophy is "上好一门课" (teaching one good course), aiming to strengthen teacher ethics, hone teaching fundamentals, and inspire young teachers to update teaching concepts and master modern teaching methods.

**Organizers**: Hosted by 北京华思培教育科技院 (Beijing Huasipei Education Science and Technology Institute), co-organized by 湖北金师学堂教育科技有限公司 and 武汉市龙海洪顺会展有限责任公司, with promotion from 高校教师发展工作室 and 高教新智荟.

**Event Format**: In-person at 武汉四季鑫宝来酒店 (87 雄楚大道, Wuchang District, Wuhan) plus online streaming. April 26: registration; April 27-28: full-day training (in-person + live-stream + playback); April 29: departure.

**Target Audience**: Young backbone teachers from universities; teaching management personnel; teams and individuals preparing for teaching competitions at all levels; teachers engaged in "金课" (golden course) construction or curriculum reform.

**Honored Speakers** (all first-prize winners of the 6th National Competition and other distinguished educators):
1. 郑用琏 - Professor and doctoral supervisor at Huazhong Agricultural University School of Life Science and Technology; first-generation National Teaching Master and former judge of the National Young Teachers Teaching Competition; enjoys State Council special government allowance.
2. 谌援 - Professor at Hubei University of Technology School of Materials and Chemical Engineering; PhD from Aix-Marseille University; 6th Competition Engineering first prize; Hubei Province May 1st Labor Medal (2022).
3. 于赫 - Associate Professor at Hainan University School of Marxism; 6th Competition Ideological-political course first prize; member of the Central Committee Youth League's 20th Party Congress publicity team.
4. 陈蓓 - Associate Professor at Central China Normal University School of Literature; 6th Competition Liberal Arts first prize; Hubei Province May 1st Labor Medal.
5. 周敏 - Associate Professor at Huazhong University of Science and Technology Tongji Medical College; 6th Competition Medicine first prize; Harvard Medical School joint-trained PhD; 2022 Hubei Province May 1st Labor Medal.
6. 罗山梦黛 - Associate Professor at Hubei University of Technology Chip Industry College; 6th Competition Science category first prize; April 2023.

**Training Schedule**:
- April 27 (09:00-12:00): 郑用琏 - "备赛青教赛——从评委的视角" (Preparing for the Competition - From a Judge's Perspective), covering how to recognize the competition, teaching design evaluation, standards for first-class university classrooms, and teaching reflection.
- April 27 (14:00-17:00): 谌援 - "四维穿透，由繁入简——青教赛工科课堂教学设计与实践" (Engineering classroom teaching design and practice), covering competition system interpretation, engineering classroom competition face, teaching design experience, practical example via 《热膨胀》(thermal expansion) section, preparation suggestions, and engineering classroom pursuit.
- April 27 (19:00-21:00): 于赫 - "绵绵用力，久久为功，止于至善" reflections on preparing for the competition, covering lesson polishing and growth, competition-to-teaching feedback, and moral education and values.
- April 28 (09:00-12:00): 陈蓓 - "从日常教学到教学竞赛" (From daily teaching to competition), covering interpreting scoring standards (content, organization, language and teaching demeanor, teaching effectiveness), selecting teaching segments (completeness, academic rigor, logic), and optimizing daily teaching.
- April 28 (14:00-17:00): 周敏 - "从青教赛浅谈医学教学" (Medical teaching from the competition perspective), covering competition scoring rules and medical classroom teaching analysis (four realms of medical teaching design; example of urinary system stones).
- April 28 (19:00-21:00): 罗山梦黛 - "论理科课堂教学探索与实践" (Science classroom teaching exploration and practice), covering scoring standards, and classroom teaching analysis (logic, inspiration, ideological-political content, frontier content).

**Fees**: Online 880 元/person; in-person 1880 元/person; institutional online registration 19800 元/institution (unlimited participants). Accommodation 350 元/room/night (single or twin same price); meals and lodging arranged uniformly but at participants' own expense. Training certificate of 24 hours issued by 北京华思培教育科技院 upon completion.

**Payment**: Online fees collected by 湖北金师学堂教育科技有限公司 (bank: ICBC Wuhan Yangjiawan Branch; account: 3202 1630 0906 0091 627), with formal invoices issued. In-person fees paid on registration day to 武汉市龙海洪顺会展有限责任公司.

**Contact**: 翟东升 at 18801071311 (WeChat same number); email: 296272384@qq.com.

The notice is dated April 2024 and issued jointly by 北京华思培教育科技院 and 湖北金师学堂教育科技有限公司.

args.summary:
This webpage is the homepage/links page of the China Vocational Education Network (中国职业技术教育网, www.chinazy.org), which serves as a national-level vocational education portal (国家级职业教育门户). The site provides access to major sections including News (要闻), Association Work (学会工作), News & Information (新闻资讯), Policies & Regulations (政策法规), Industry Observation (产业观察), Featured Columns & Topics (专题专栏), and Public Services (公共服务), along with search, login, and registration functions.

The primary content of this page is an extensive curated collection of official link directories organized into the following categories:

1. **State Council Departments (国务院部门网站)**: Contains links to all major Chinese government ministries and agencies including the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Commerce, People's Bank of China, among dozens of others.

2. **Local Governments (地方政府)**: Links to the provincial government websites for all 31 mainland Chinese provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, etc.), plus Hong Kong SAR, Macau SAR, Taiwan, and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

3. **Education Administrative Departments (教育行政部门)**: Links to the education departments/commissions of all Chinese provinces and major cities, including Beijing Municipal Education Commission, Shanghai Education Commission, Guangdong Provincial Department of Education, and special municipal education departments for Dalian, Qingdao, Ningbo, Xiamen, Shenzhen, and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

4. **Academic Associations (社团)**: Links to the China Association of Higher Education, Chinese Society of Education, Chinese Adult Education Association, and Chinese Institute of Electronics.

5. **Media (媒体)**: Links to major Chinese news outlets including People's Daily (人民网), Xinhua (新华网), CCTV (央视网), China Daily, China Youth Daily, China Education News, and major commercial portals like Tencent, Sohu, Sina, NetEase, and Phoenix.

6. **Educational Institutions (院校)**: Links to vocational colleges including Beijing Vocational College of Transportation, Shenzhen Polytechnic, Shandong Urban Construction Vocational College, Binzhou Polytechnic, Guangdong Open University, and others.

7. **Enterprises (企业)**: Links to major companies involved in vocational education including China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, Sinopec, China Mobile, Lenovo Education, iFlytek, Ali Cloud University, and Harbin Institute of Technology Haidu Robotics.

The page also includes site registration details (京ICP备09048925号-1, 京公网安备 11010502046194号) and acknowledges technical support from Wanhe Technology and Boda Software. The site is copyrighted by the China Vocational and Technical Education Network.

You are a research assistant conducting research on the user's input topic. For context, today's date is Sun Aug 23, 2026.

<Task>
Your job is to use tools to gather information about the user's input topic.
You can use any of the tools provided to you to find resources that can help answer the research question. You can call these tools in series or in parallel, your research is conducted in a tool-calling loop.
</Task>

<Available Tools>
You have access to two main tools:
1. **tavily_search**: For conducting web searches to gather information
2. **think_tool**: For reflection and strategic planning during research


**CRITICAL: Use think_tool after each search to reflect on results and plan next steps. Do not call think_tool with the tavily_search or any other tools. It should be to reflect on the results of the search.**
</Available Tools>

<Instructions>
Think like a human researcher with limited time. Follow these steps:

1. **Read the question carefully** - What specific information does the user need?
2. **Start with broader searches** - Use broad, comprehensive queries first
3. **After each search, pause and assess** - Do I have enough to answer? What's still missing?
4. **Execute narrower searches as you gather information** - Fill in the gaps
5. **Stop when you can answer confidently** - Don't keep searching for perfection
</Instructions>

<Hard Limits>
**Tool Call Budgets** (Prevent excessive searching):
- **Simple queries**: Use 2-3 search tool calls maximum
- **Complex queries**: Use up to 5 search tool calls maximum
- **Always stop**: After 5 search tool calls if you cannot find the right sources

**Stop Immediately When**:
- You can answer the user's question comprehensively
- You have 3+ relevant examples/sources for the question
- Your last 2 searches returned similar information
</Hard Limits>

<Show Your Thinking>
After each search tool call, use think_tool to analyze the results:
- What key information did I find?
- What's missing?
- Do I have enough to answer the question comprehensively?

URL: https://edu.sh.gov.cn/xwzx_gnxw/20230425/f45373f0766941c5b095926b735ead01.html

SUMMARY:
<summary>
The 6th National College Young Teachers' Teaching Competition (全国高校青年教师教学竞赛) finals were held at Tsinghua University in Beijing from April 20-24, 2023. Co-hosted by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions (中华全国总工会) and the Ministry of Education, the competition featured five categories: Liberal Arts, Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, and Ideological/Political Theory courses.

Five contestants won first-place awards in their categories, including Liang Sisi (Tsinghua University), Zhou Feng (Shandong Normal University), Gao Xiaofeng (Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Zhu Guiquan (Sichuan University), and Zhao Kun (Zhejiang University). Participants were required to submit teaching syllabi, 16-class-hour teaching design plans, and corresponding PPTs before the competition. In the finals, contestants randomly drew a teaching segment to deliver a simulated classroom lesson and write a teaching reflection, scored by 7 judges on teaching design, classroom teaching, and reflection.

The competition had preliminary and final stages: nearly 500,000 young teachers from over 1,800 universities participated in school, municipal, and provincial-level competitions (60% university participation rate). A total of 8,550 contestants from 1,501 schools competed in provincial selections, and 158 contestants from 121 schools across 31 provinces and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps advanced to the finals and won awards.

The Ministry of Education stated that winning awards will be reflected in teacher title/promotion evaluations and relevant honors, while the All-China Federation of Trade Unions will apply for the "National May 1st Labor Medal" for qualifying first-place winners the following year. Since 2012, the federation has organized 5 university-level and 3 primary/secondary-level teaching competitions, attracting over one million teachers. The competition is now the largest-scale, most comprehensive national high-level teaching competition and is included in the federation's "14th Five-Year Plan" national leading labor and skills competition.
</summary>

URL: http://shtyxyxb.xml-journal.net/cn/article/pdf/preview/10.16099/j.sus.2024.10.03.0001.pdf

SUMMARY:
<summary>
This academic article by Zhao Fuxue (Wuhan Sports University), published in the Journal of Shanghai University of Sport (2025, Vol. 49, Issue 4, pp. 20-29), examines the problems and solutions in curriculum ideological and political (CIP) teaching innovation for physical education (PE) courses in the "National College Teachers' Teaching Innovation Competition" (教创赛).

KEY CONTEXT AND STATISTICS:
- The competition is organized by the China Association of Higher Education and is the only university teaching competition listed in the Ministry of Education's retained competition list.
- First held in 2021, it has been held annually for 4 editions (through 2024). The 4th edition (November 2024) attracted 104,000 teachers from 1,249 universities across 32 regions, with 25,000+ advancing to provincial rounds and 1,779 teachers from 483 courses reaching the national finals (73 first prizes, 170 second prizes, 240 third prizes). Only 0.46% of participating teachers won national awards, earning it the nickname "Olympics" of teaching competitions.
- PE courses have consistently reached national finals (winning 1 second and 1 third prize in edition 1; 2 third prizes in edition 2; 1 first and 2 third prizes in edition 3; 1 second and 2 third prizes in edition 4). Winning PE courses include "Sports, Technology and Wisdom Life," "College PE-Fitness Yoga," martial arts courses, "Chinese Wrestling," "Sports Anatomy," and "Badminton" (the latter won in the CIP track).
- PE award-winning courses represent only 0.5%-0.8% of all national winners, making them "disadvantaged groups" in the "elite team."
- From the 3rd edition onward, a dedicated CIP track was added, making CIP capability directly tied to competition results.

CIP CONSTRUCTION CHARACTERISTICS OF PE COURSES (5 features):
1. Focus on fundamental moral education task (立德树人) - centering student development, integrating value shaping, knowledge transmission, and ability cultivation.
2. Centering on real teaching problems - distinguishing between theory course knowledge internalization and motor skill acquisition; e.g., addressing common issues like students excusing themselves from class.
3. Grounded in disciplinary/professional education characteristics - technology courses emphasize sports spirit and ethics; theory courses cultivate patriotism and cultural confidence; practice courses enhance social responsibility.
4. Grasping CIP construction connotation - treating CIP as a teaching concept requiring integration with professional education.
5. Emphasizing achievement promotion and dissemination - results typically concentrated in "Chinese Sports Spirit," "Chinese Sports Stories," and "Olympic Champion Deeds" materials.

TEACHING REQUIREMENTS (4 dimensions):
1. Continuously improve teaching philosophy - the "trinity" (三位一体) of value shaping, knowledge transmission, and ability cultivation.
2. Standardize teaching design - through teaching syllabi, classroom videos/materials, and innovation reports.
3. Precisely position teaching points - mainstream CIP resources include Chinese sports spirit, Beijing Winter Olympics spirit, and sports history; high-frequency keywords include winning glory for the country, tenacious struggle, and teamwork.
4. Systematically upgrade teaching methods - upgrading traditional demonstration methods with immersive, case-based, problem-oriented, and situational teaching approaches.

FIVE MAIN PROBLEMS IDENTIFIED:
1. Innovation goals become "CIP for CIP's sake" - blocking content upgrade pathways (e.g., 3 different regions' "Sports Anatomy" courses all claiming to "contribute to Healthy China" without methods; 3 "Basketball" courses listing patriotism/collectivism without implementation support).
2. Innovation points show "increment" not supporting "quality" - innovation points grew from 1-2 to 3-5 (up to 7 for some courses like "Sports and Health" and "Sports Dance"), but quality lagged, with some teachers confusing overall teaching innovation goals with CIP goals and overusing abundant materials ("over-ideological" phenomenon).
3. Deliberate "reconstruction" of innovation methods interferes with targeted integration of CIP resources - methods like scenario-based demonstration and technology-assisted decomposition sometimes led to forced inclusion of current affairs, military thought, and classical culture resources.
4. Excessive "packaging" of innovation models blurs case application boundaries - including inflated claims about contributing to sports power, "Smart Made China," and "Great Craftsmen" cultivation.
5. "Isolated" innovation evaluation weakens persuasiveness of achievement promotion - evaluations are overwhelmingly positive and one-dimensional, rarely addressing improvement directions.

FIVE SOLUTION PATHS:
1. Innovation goals should highlight PE-CIP's advantage in leading students' higher-order ability cultivation - connecting sports' ideological education function with moral education, linking to students' experience/achievement in sports learning and internalization into behavioral norms and confidence ("I can").
2. Innovation points should strengthen support for and interpretation of the CIP teaching process - requiring new perspectives, new understanding, and new processes (e.g., public PE courses designing points around "enjoying fun, strengthening physique, improving personality, and tempering will"; professional courses focused on health-first, patriotism, and traditional culture education).
3. Innovation methods should promote close integration of CIP resources into teaching - aligning with the "learn-practice-compete" and "learn-research-train" processes, ensuring consistent expression of methods, content, and ideological resources.
4. Innovation models should make cases closely respond to teaching needs - per the "Guide to Curriculum Ideological and Political Construction in Higher Education Institutions," PE courses should establish health-first education, emphasize patriotism and traditional culture education, and cultivate tenacious struggle; using typical cases (sports celebrity deeds, key sports events, campus stories) to strengthen national sentiment, teamwork, rule consciousness, and international vision (e.g., "School PE" and "PE Curriculum and Teaching Theory" courses addressing low willingness to teach).
5. Achievement application should expand practical support pathways for CIP teaching evaluation - combining "addition of effectiveness and subtraction of content" for "fewer but better" achievements, ensuring consistency between outcomes and evaluation.

The paper concludes that teaching competitions ultimately serve to promote teaching through competition, and future PE-CIP innovation must link content with national development, social needs, and the spirit of the times while expanding PE courses' "educating body, morality, and ability" functions and supporting students' sense of responsibility for improving the whole nation's physical fitness.
</summary>

【赛制与赛道】大赛采用校赛、省赛、全国赛三级赛制，共设置新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科、基础课程、课程思政、产教融合、人工智能、实验教学共9个赛道。其中"四新"、基础课程、课程思政赛道下设正高组、副高组、中级及以下组；产教融合赛道分部属高校、地方高校2个小组；人工智能和实验教学为新增赛道。

【参赛要求】参赛对象为全国普通本科高校和军队院校的在职教师。主讲教师近5年需对所参赛本科课程讲授2轮及以上，参赛课程须纳入本科人才培养方案。产教融合赛道要求团队至少包含1名从行业企业聘请的兼职教师且深度参与教育教学2年及以上。已获往届全国赛一等奖的主讲教师不能再次参赛，二、三等奖获得者不能连续参赛。

【赛程安排】校赛为2025年11月至2026年1月，省赛为2026年2月至4月，全国赛网络评审为2026年5月至6月，全国赛现场赛于2026年7月20日至23日在南京大学、南京理工大学举行。大赛官网为nticct.cahe.edu.cn。

【规模数据】本届大赛覆盖全国32个赛区所有本科高校，共1308所高校参赛，13.8万名教师参加校赛、4.5万名教师参加省赛，699门课程的2697名教师入围全国现场赛评审。

【比赛内容】包括课堂教学实录视频、创新成果报告和教学设计创新汇报。现场赛通常包括不超过12分钟的教学设计创新汇报、5分钟成果汇报和10分钟现场讲课，随后专家提问交流。

【赛况亮点】北京科技大学储继迅教学团队获"基础课程正高组"一等奖；西安交大2门课程进入现场赛获一、二等奖；同济大学获上海市特等奖6项、名列上海高校第一；福建省24个团队入围现场评审获一等奖6项、江苏大学田丰伟和孙丝丝团队获新农科、新文科正高组全国二等奖；湖南人文科技学院获新农科中级以下组二等奖第一名；珠海科技学院成为广东省唯一获国赛奖项的民办本科高校。

【赛事意义】该大赛是唯一一项纳入教育部《直属单位三评一竞赛保留项目清单》的综合性教师教学竞赛，全国赛获奖课程的课堂教学实录视频经授权后将上线国家智慧教育公共服务平台展示。

This webpage is an official notice (document number 高教师培﹝2024﹞008 号) announcing a training seminar titled "第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛备赛指导暨教师教学技能提升专题培训会" (Preparation Guidance for the 7th National Young University Teachers Teaching Competition and Teacher Teaching Skills Enhancement Seminar), held April 26-29, 2024, in Wuhan, Hubei.

**Background**: The 7th National University Young Teachers Teaching Competition (青教赛), jointly organized by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and the Ministry of Education, is scheduled for August 2024 at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The competition has five categories: Liberal Arts (文科), Science (理科), Engineering (工科), Medicine (医科), and Ideological and Political Courses (思政课专项). The competition's philosophy is "上好一门课" (teaching one good course), aiming to strengthen teacher ethics, hone teaching fundamentals, and inspire young teachers to update teaching concepts and master modern teaching methods.

**Organizers**: Hosted by 北京华思培教育科技院 (Beijing Huasipei Education Science and Technology Institute), co-organized by 湖北金师学堂教育科技有限公司 and 武汉市龙海洪顺会展有限责任公司, with promotion from 高校教师发展工作室 and 高教新智荟.

**Event Format**: In-person at 武汉四季鑫宝来酒店 (87 雄楚大道, Wuchang District, Wuhan) plus online streaming. April 26: registration; April 27-28: full-day training (in-person + live-stream + playback); April 29: departure.

**Target Audience**: Young backbone teachers from universities; teaching management personnel; teams and individuals preparing for teaching competitions at all levels; teachers engaged in "金课" (golden course) construction or curriculum reform.

**Honored Speakers** (all first-prize winners of the 6th National Competition and other distinguished educators):
1. 郑用琏 - Professor and doctoral supervisor at Huazhong Agricultural University School of Life Science and Technology; first-generation National Teaching Master and former judge of the National Young Teachers Teaching Competition; enjoys State Council special government allowance.
2. 谌援 - Professor at Hubei University of Technology School of Materials and Chemical Engineering; PhD from Aix-Marseille University; 6th Competition Engineering first prize; Hubei Province May 1st Labor Medal (2022).
3. 于赫 - Associate Professor at Hainan University School of Marxism; 6th Competition Ideological-political course first prize; member of the Central Committee Youth League's 20th Party Congress publicity team.
4. 陈蓓 - Associate Professor at Central China Normal University School of Literature; 6th Competition Liberal Arts first prize; Hubei Province May 1st Labor Medal.
5. 周敏 - Associate Professor at Huazhong University of Science and Technology Tongji Medical College; 6th Competition Medicine first prize; Harvard Medical School joint-trained PhD; 2022 Hubei Province May 1st Labor Medal.
6. 罗山梦黛 - Associate Professor at Hubei University of Technology Chip Industry College; 6th Competition Science category first prize; April 2023.

**Training Schedule**:
- April 27 (09:00-12:00): 郑用琏 - "备赛青教赛——从评委的视角" (Preparing for the Competition - From a Judge's Perspective), covering how to recognize the competition, teaching design evaluation, standards for first-class university classrooms, and teaching reflection.
- April 27 (14:00-17:00): 谌援 - "四维穿透，由繁入简——青教赛工科课堂教学设计与实践" (Engineering classroom teaching design and practice), covering competition system interpretation, engineering classroom competition face, teaching design experience, practical example via 《热膨胀》(thermal expansion) section, preparation suggestions, and engineering classroom pursuit.
- April 27 (19:00-21:00): 于赫 - "绵绵用力，久久为功，止于至善" reflections on preparing for the competition, covering lesson polishing and growth, competition-to-teaching feedback, and moral education and values.
- April 28 (09:00-12:00): 陈蓓 - "从日常教学到教学竞赛" (From daily teaching to competition), covering interpreting scoring standards (content, organization, language and teaching demeanor, teaching effectiveness), selecting teaching segments (completeness, academic rigor, logic), and optimizing daily teaching.
- April 28 (14:00-17:00): 周敏 - "从青教赛浅谈医学教学" (Medical teaching from the competition perspective), covering competition scoring rules and medical classroom teaching analysis (four realms of medical teaching design; example of urinary system stones).
- April 28 (19:00-21:00): 罗山梦黛 - "论理科课堂教学探索与实践" (Science classroom teaching exploration and practice), covering scoring standards, and classroom teaching analysis (logic, inspiration, ideological-political content, frontier content).

**Fees**: Online 880 元/person; in-person 1880 元/person; institutional online registration 19800 元/institution (unlimited participants). Accommodation 350 元/room/night (single or twin same price); meals and lodging arranged uniformly but at participants' own expense. Training certificate of 24 hours issued by 北京华思培教育科技院 upon completion.

**Payment**: Online fees collected by 湖北金师学堂教育科技有限公司 (bank: ICBC Wuhan Yangjiawan Branch; account: 3202 1630 0906 0091 627), with formal invoices issued. In-person fees paid on registration day to 武汉市龙海洪顺会展有限责任公司.

**Contact**: 翟东升 at 18801071311 (WeChat same number); email: 296272384@qq.com.

The notice is dated April 2024 and issued jointly by 北京华思培教育科技院 and 湖北金师学堂教育科技有限公司.

# 第六届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛决赛举办

2023-04-25　来源：《中国教育报》收藏

本报北京4月24日讯（记者 张欣）4月20日至24日，由中华全国总工会、教育部联合主办的第六届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛决赛在清华大学举办。经过激烈角逐，清华大学梁思思、山东师范大学周峰、上海交通大学高晓沨、四川大学朱桂全、浙江大学赵坤等5名选手获得一等奖第一名。

　　据悉，本次竞赛设置文科、理科、工科、医科、思想政治课专项5个组别，要求每名选手在赛前提交参赛课程的教学大纲、16个学时的教学设计方案和对应的课堂教学节段PPT。决赛阶段，由选手现场随机抽取一个教学节段，进行模拟课堂教学并撰写教学反思。7名评委对教学设计、课堂教学和教学反思分别打分。

　　本次竞赛分初赛和决赛两个阶段。1800多所高校的近50万名青年教师参加了校（院）、市、省等多层级比拼，高校参赛率达到60％。1501所学校的8550名选手参加了省级选拔赛，来自31个省（区、市）和新疆生产建设兵团121所学校的158名选手参加决赛并获奖。

　　教育部明确，对于所有获奖选手，将在教师职称评审中体现教育教学实绩，在相关荣誉表彰等方面予以倾斜。全国总工会明确，对获得各组别一等奖第一名且符合条件的选手，将在次年“五一”表彰中，按程序申报“全国五一劳动奖章”。

　　2012年以来，全国总工会组织了5届高校青教赛和3届中小学青教赛，吸引逾百万名教师参与竞赛，一大批优秀青年教师在竞赛中脱颖而出。目前，青年教师教学竞赛已成为参与面最广、学科门类最全、组织规模最大的全国性高水平教学类竞赛，被纳入全国总工会“十四五”全国引领性劳动和技能竞赛，为一大批青年教师提供了实践历练、成长成才的广阔舞台。
