args.summary:
This is a news article from China's Ministry of Education (moe.gov.cn) reporting on the 6th National College Young Teachers Teaching Competition finals, held April 20-24, 2023, at Tsinghua University in Beijing. The competition was jointly organized by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and the Ministry of Education.

Key facts:
- Five contestants won first place in their categories: Liang Sisi (Tsinghua University), Zhou Feng (Shandong Normal University), Gao Xiaofeng (Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Zhu Guiquan (Sichuan University), and Zhao Kun (Zhejiang University), in the humanities, sciences, engineering, medicine, and ideological-political course categories respectively.
- Contestants were required to submit a course syllabus, 16 class-hours of instructional design plans, and corresponding classroom teaching section PPTs before the competition.
- In the finals, contestants randomly drew a teaching section to deliver a simulated classroom lesson and write a teaching reflection. Seven judges scored instructional design, classroom teaching, and teaching reflection separately.
- The competition had preliminary and final rounds. Nearly 500,000 young teachers from over 1,800 universities participated in school, municipal, and provincial level competitions, with a 60% university participation rate. 8,550 contestants from 1,501 schools participated in provincial preliminaries, and 158 contestants from 121 schools across 31 provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities) and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps won awards in the finals.
- The Ministry of Education stated that all winners would have their teaching performance reflected in teacher title evaluations and receive preference in related honors/commendations.
- The All-China Federation of Trade Unions said that first-place winners in each category who meet conditions could be nominated for the "National May Day Labor Medal" at the next year's May 1st commendation.
- Since 2012, the federation has organized 5 editions of the college competition and 3 editions for primary/secondary schools, attracting over one million participating teachers. The competition has become the most widely participated, most comprehensive in disciplines, and largest-scale national high-level teaching competition.

发布时间：2026-06-16 浏览次数：10 文章来源：工会、本科生院

分享至：

6月13日至16日，第六届江苏省高校青年教师教学竞赛暨第八届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛选拔赛决赛在南京举行。南京邮电大学通信与信息工程学院王婕老师、理学院王新光老师和经济学院赵富森老师分别获工科组特等奖（唯一）、理科组一等奖、文科组二等奖，南邮获优秀组织奖。王婕老师将代表江苏省工科组教师参加第八届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛。

获奖教师

　　江苏省高校青年教师教学竞赛是省内覆盖面最广、权威性最高、影响力最大的高校青年教师教学竞技赛事之一。竞赛聚焦新时代高校课堂教学改革，围绕教学设计、课堂教学、教学反思开展综合竞赛，全面考察青年教师的专业功底、教学创新能力和立德树人综合素养，是检验高校师资队伍建设成效、课堂教学质量与人才培养水平的重要省级平台。全省110所高校、88个代表队、214位参赛教师参加决赛。

　　备赛期间，校工会联合本科生院未来教师发展中心统筹部署、精心组织，严格按照省赛评审标准开展第四届校青年教师教学技能竞赛，完成校内遴选、专项打磨与集中培训。各参赛教师所在学院全力支持，校院两级专业指导团队从课程教学设计、教学内容优化、教学方法创新、课件选材制作、课堂节奏把控、板书板画设计、教学反思撰写等环节进行10余轮精细化打磨与指导。参赛教师潜心钻研教材、精心雕琢课堂、反复模拟演练，将专业特色、教学理念、思政元素与育人温度融入课程。

　　南邮将持续坚守育人初心，聚焦课堂教学主阵地，持续完善青年教师培养体系，持续深化教育教学改革，以各类教学竞赛为抓手，以赛赋能、以赛提质、以赛育人，充分发挥优秀青年教师的示范引领作用，鼓励全体教师潜心教学、匠心育人，不断提升课堂教学质量与人才培养核心竞争力，为学校高质量内涵式发展、培养高素质创新型人才筑牢坚实教学根基。

args.summary:
Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications (NJUPT) news article reporting on the 6th Jiangsu Provincial University Young Teachers Teaching Competition, which also served as the selection round for the 8th National University Young Teachers Teaching Competition. The finals were held in Nanjing from June 13-16, 2026. Three NJUPT teachers received awards: Wang Jie (School of Communication and Information Engineering) won the Special Prize (the only one) in the Engineering category, Wang Xingguang (School of Science) won First Prize in the Science category, and Zhao Fusen (School of Economics) won Second Prize in the Liberal Arts category. NJUPT also received the Outstanding Organization Award. Wang Jie will represent Jiangsu Province's engineering teachers at the 8th National University Young Teachers Teaching Competition.

The competition is described as one of the most comprehensive, authoritative, and influential teaching competition events for young university teachers in the province. It focused on new-era classroom teaching reform, evaluating teaching design, classroom teaching, and teaching reflection to assess teachers' professional knowledge, innovative teaching abilities, and comprehensive competence in moral education. A total of 110 universities, 88 teams, and 214 participating teachers competed in the finals.

During the preparation period, NJUPT's labor union and the Undergraduate School's Future Teacher Development Center organized training, including internal selection, specialized polishing, and concentrated training. School and faculty-level professional guidance teams provided over 10 rounds of detailed refinement covering teaching design, content optimization, teaching method innovation, courseware selection and production, classroom pace control, blackboard design, and teaching reflection writing. NJUPT stated its commitment to continue improving the young teacher training system and deepening educational reform, using teaching competitions to empower and improve teaching quality.

# 喜报：我院教师在第六届江苏省高校青年教师教学竞赛中荣获佳绩

6月16日，第六届江苏省高校青年教师教学竞赛暨第八届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛选拔赛圆满落幕。我院教师在此次大赛中表现突出，苏梦茹、张爽两位老师双双斩获医科组一等奖，全校共计斩获五项单项奖，创参赛以来获奖数量新高，我院教师贡献了其中两项一等奖，充分展现了医学院在青年教师教学能力培养和课程改革创新方面的扎实成效。

（苏梦茹老师在参赛现场）

（张爽老师在参赛现场）

本届竞赛由江苏省总工会、江苏省教育厅、共青团江苏省委联合主办，江苏省教育科技工会承办，大赛紧扣“上好一门课”核心理念，分为文科、理科、工科、医科、思想政治课专项五大组别，全方位考核青年教师的教学设计、课堂把控、语言表达、教学创新以及课程思政融入等综合能力。竞赛内容由教学设计、课堂教学和教学反思三部分组成，赛制严谨、考查全面，吸引了全省众多高校优秀青年教师同台竞技。我院两位教师在激烈角逐中沉着应战，凭借扎实的专业功底、新颖的教学方法和饱满的育人热情，赢得评委高度认可，最终全部荣获一等奖，彰显了医学院教师队伍过硬的教学素养。

医学院深入贯彻南京大学“奋进行动”部署要求，始终秉持创新育人理念，致力于打造高质量的教育教学队伍。学院高度重视此次竞赛，坚持“以赛促教、以赛促创、以赛促训、以赛育人”的工作导向，会同各附属医院构建起“院级遴选、校级竞赛、专项集训”三级联动的选拔与备赛体系。自2025年12月起，学院积极配合本科生院、校工会，设立教师教学发展工作小组，常态化开展名师“传帮带”工作。备赛期间，学院组建由教学名师、往届获奖教师及教育学专家构成的导师团队，通过专题讲座、磨课试讲等形式开展实战化培训，精心打磨教学设计、课堂互动和教学反思等各个环节。学院从多方位给予全面保障，与参赛教师共同制定备赛策略、精炼教学报告、优化课件，并完成了多轮试讲、培训研讨和课堂实录拍摄等工作，确保每位教师以最佳状态迎接决赛。

此次取得两项一等奖的突破性优异成绩，是医学院深化教学改革、加强教师队伍建设成效的集中体现。学院将以此为新的起点，持续深化教育教学创新，营造追求卓越的教学文化，积极落实南京大学“奋进行动”关于建设一流教育队伍、培养顶尖创新人才的目标要求，不断完善“以赛促教、以赛促学、以赛促创”的长效机制，持续提升人才培养质量，为加快建设“中国特色、世界一流”南京大学贡献医学智慧和力量。

**祝贺苏梦茹、张爽两位老师！**

**致敬所有默默耕耘在教学一线的医学教育者！**

6月16日，第六届江苏省高校青年教师教学竞赛暨第八届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛选拔赛圆满落幕。我院教师在此次大赛中表现突出，苏梦茹、张爽两位老师双双斩获医科组一等奖，全校共计斩获五项单项奖，创参赛以来获奖数量新高，我院教师贡献了其中两项一等奖. (On June 16, the 6th Jiangsu Province University Young Teacher Teaching Competition and the selection for the 8th National competition concluded. Su Mengru and Zhang Shuang both won first prizes in the medical category.)

本届竞赛由江苏省总工会、江苏省教育厅、共青团江苏省委联合主办...大赛紧扣"上好一门课"核心理念，分为文科、理科、工科、医科、思想政治课专项五大组别，全方位考核青年教师的教学设计、课堂把控、语言表达、教学创新以及课程思政融入等综合能力。竞赛内容由教学设计、课堂教学和教学反思三部分组成. (The competition covers five categories and tests teaching design, classroom control, language expression, teaching innovation, and ideological-political integration.)

学院...构建起"院级遴选、校级竞赛、专项集训"三级联动的选拔与备赛体系。自2025年12月起，学院积极配合本科生院、校工会，设立教师教学发展工作小组，常态化开展名师"传帮带"工作. (Since December 2025, the school established a teacher teaching development working group and built a three-tier preparation system.)

祝贺苏梦茹、张爽两位老师！致敬所有默默耕耘在教学一线的医学教育者！(Congratulations to Su Mengru and Zhang Shuang! Salute to all medical educators working quietly on the teaching frontlines.)

This is a webpage from Nanjing University's School of Medicine (南京大学医学院) announcing that two of its faculty members, Su Mengru (苏梦茹) and Zhang Shuang (张爽), each won first prizes (一等奖) in the medical category at the 6th Jiangsu Province University Young Teacher Teaching Competition, which also served as the selection round for the 8th National University Young Teacher Teaching Competition. The competition concluded on June 16 (2026), and the school contributed two of the university's five total awards, setting a new record for the number of awards won.

Key details:
- The competition was co-hosted by the Jiangsu Provincial Federation of Trade Unions, Jiangsu Provincial Department of Education, and Jiangsu Provincial Communist Youth League Committee, and organized by the Jiangsu Provincial Education and Science Trade Union.
- It was structured around the theme of "delivering one excellent course" (上好一门课) and covered five categories: liberal arts, science, engineering, medicine, and ideological/political theory courses.
- The competition evaluated instructional design, classroom control, language expression, teaching innovation, and integration of ideological-political elements into courses. It consisted of three parts: instructional design, classroom teaching, and teaching reflection.
- The school had been preparing since December 2025, establishing a teacher teaching development working group and building a "college-level selection, university-level competition, and special training" (院级遴选、校级竞赛、专项集训) three-tier preparation system, with mentorship from teaching masters, past award winners, and education experts.
- The school emphasized a work orientation of "promoting teaching, innovation, training, and talent cultivation through competition" (以赛促教、以赛促创、以赛促训、以赛育人).

The page also contains the School of Medicine's website navigation (including its affiliated hospitals, faculty, education programs, research platforms, and international exchange sections) and a list of recent updates (from August 2026), including a Nanjing University-University of Western Australia global research program, a national medical innovation competition award, a visit to the University of Melbourne, and summer social practice activities. Contact information: Nanjing University School of Medicine, No. 22 Hankou Road, Nanjing, postal code 210093, phone 025-83593192, email yingfeng@nju.edu.cn.

After fierce competition, our school's Basic Medical College teacher Zhao Ting won a first prize in the medical category, and Marxism College teacher Hu Xiaoling won a second prize in the ideological and political course special category, achieving the best result in the history of our school in this competition and a historic breakthrough with a first prize!"
args.summary:
This is a news article from Zhejiang University of Chinese Medicine (ZCMU) admissions website reporting on the university's outstanding results at the 7th National Young Teachers' Teaching Competition, which concluded on August 30 (the article appears related to a competition that year, published on the school's news page).

Key results:
- Zhao Ting from the School of Basic Medicine won a First Prize (一等奖) in the Medical category (医科组).
- Hu Xiaoling from the School of Marxism won a Second Prize (二等奖) in the Ideological and Political Course special category (思想政治课专项组).
- This represents the school's best-ever performance in this competition and a historic breakthrough with its first First Prize.

Competition background:
- The National Young Teachers' Teaching Competition is considered the most widely participated, most influential, largest, and most demanding national-level teaching competition.
- The finals were hosted by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and the Ministry of Education, organized by the China Education, Culture, Sports, Health and Trade Union and the Ministry of Education's Teacher Work Department, and co-organized by the Shanghai Education Union and Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
- The competition has five categories: Liberal Arts (文科), Science (理科), Engineering (工科), Medicine (医科), and Ideological and Political Courses.
- 31 provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities) and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps selected contestants from their provincial winners.
- More than 300,000 young teachers from 2,028 universities in China participated at various levels; 159 contestants from 130 universities competed in the finals in Shanghai.
- Each category awarded 5 first prizes, 10 second prizes, and several third prizes.

Zhejiang Province sent 5 contestants to the national finals. Zhao Ting and Hu Xiaoling stood out from 136 provincial contestants to represent Zhejiang in the Medicine and Ideological/Political categories.

Preparation: The university placed high importance on the competition, launching intensive training involving the school union, the Faculty Development Center, and the Academic Affairs Office. Multiple rounds of course-polishing sessions were held with internal and external experts for targeted guidance. During the summer, contestants and advisors overcame the heat for high-intensity pre-competition training including special lectures, practical drills, expert guidance, and material refinement.

Vice-President Huang Jianbo (黄建波) provided ongoing guidance and monitored competition preparation.

The university stated it will use the competition to promote teacher development centered on moral education (立德树人), strengthen professional ethics and teaching fundamentals, and build a high-quality, professional teaching staff to accelerate the construction of a first-class traditional Chinese medicine university.

args.summary:
This article announces the 8th National College Young Teacher Teaching Competition (全国高校青年教师教学竞赛) national finals scheduled to begin on August 26 (the article context indicates the finals are planned for August 2026). The competition is jointly organized by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and the Ministry of Education, with provincial selection rounds and national finals phases.

The competition's purpose is to strengthen teacher ethics, hone basic teaching skills, and encourage young university teachers to update educational concepts and master modern teaching methods, building a high-quality professional teaching workforce to support educational modernization.

Key details:
- Provincial selection rounds should be completed by June 30, 2026, with awards and selection methods determined by each province.
- The national finals, hosted by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and Ministry of Education, co-organized by the Chinese Educational, Scientific, Cultural, Health and Sports Workers' Union and the Ministry of Education's Teacher Work Department, and assisted by Shandong Provincial Education Union and Shandong University, are planned for August 2026.
- The finals have five categories: Liberal Arts, Sciences, Engineering, Medicine, and Ideological and Political Course specialization.
- Participants must be university teachers aged 40 or younger (born after August 31, 1985), in compliance with national laws, with good ideological and ethical character, and having continuously taught front-line courses for the past 3 academic years (2023-2026). Previous national final participants cannot compete again.

Awards structure:
- Individual awards: 5 first prizes, 10 second prizes per category, plus multiple third prizes. Winners receive trophies and certificates, with teaching achievements reflected in teacher title evaluations and recognition awards. The first-place winner in each category who meets conditions may be recommended for the "National May 1st Labor Medal."
- Collective awards: Excellent Organization Awards for units with broad coverage, high teacher participation, and outstanding organization. Units failing to hold provincial selections, failing to submit summary reports, or whose finalists face ethics/disciplinary issues may be disqualified from this award.

The organizing committee includes an office, finals review committee, supervision committee, and arbitration committee, with the office located at the Chinese Educational, Scientific, Cultural, Health and Sports Workers' Union.

args.summary:
This webpage from cnr.cn (China National Radio) announces the opening of the "Private Higher Education National Teacher Teaching Competition" (全国民办高校教师教学比赛/全国826届? — the title appears garbled but refers to the private college national teacher teaching competition). The event is scheduled with course registration opening on August 24, 2026 (2026年8月24日) at Shandong University (山东大学), with teaching activities running from August 26 to 27 (8月26日至27日).

Key details:
- Purpose: To strengthen the construction of the private higher education teacher team, showcase teaching skills, and support the development of a professional teaching faculty for high-quality independent colleges, providing support for accelerating modernization.
- Principles: Open, fair, and impartial selection with broad participation, focused on teaching practice and standardized procedures.
- Provincial selection: Conducted before June 30, 2026 by provincial education administrative departments, with participating institutions organizing selection activities to demonstrate teaching levels.
- Organization: Co-hosted by the national association (全国民办教育协会/中国民办教育协会) and Shandong Province organizations.
- Participants: Teachers aged 40 and under (born on/after August 31, 1985) with 3 academic years of teaching experience (2023-2026 academic years); participating in accordance with national policies.
- Comprehensive organization: A comprehensive leadership committee with leadership, supervision, and review committees, coordinated by the education authorities.
- Awards: Multiple award levels (5, 10, etc.), with certificates issued for teaching achievements.
- Exclusions: Institutions that haven't organized provincial selections, haven't reported nationally, or where teachers have engaged in misconduct/contract violations may be ineligible.

The page includes copyright information for cnr.cn, contact details (24-hour hotline 400-800-0088), and links to related news articles about AI integration in education and thematic news features.

关于举办首届全国高校教师教学创新大赛的通知

2020-10-27 09:20

中国高等教育学会

作者：

<https://www.eol.cn/news/>

分享：

[关注教育在线](JavaScript:;)

![教育在线公众号](https://www.eol.cn/e_images/index/2019/eolgzh.jpg)

高学会〔2020〕107号

各省、自治区、直辖市高等教育学会，行业高等教育学会，各分支机构，各赛区组委会牵头单位、有关高校：

　　为深入学习贯彻全国教育大会精神和《中国教育现代化2035》，全面落实新时代全国高等学校本科教育工作会议精神，坚持立德树人根本任务，落实“以本为本、四个回归”的要求，以“新工科、新农科、新医科、新文科”建设理念为引领，聚焦教学创新、掀起学习革命，引导高校教师潜心教书育人，形成卓越教学的价值追求和自觉行动，打造高校教学改革的风向标，全力推进高等教育“质量革命”，中国高等教育学会决定举办“首届全国高校教师教学创新大赛”(以下简称大赛)。现将有关事项通知如下：

**一、举办单位**

　　指导单位：教育部高等教育司

　　主办单位：中国高等教育学会

　　承办单位：复旦大学、北京理工大学、南京大学、浙江大学、电子科技大学、西安交通大学、中国高等教育学会大学素质教育研究分会、北京世纪超星信息技术发展有限责任公司

**二、组织机构**

　　大赛设大赛组织委员会(以下简称大赛组委会)、大赛专家委员会(以下简称大赛专委会)、大赛纪律与监督委员会(以下简称大赛监委会)和大赛仲裁委员会。省(自治区、直辖市)各赛区设赛区组委会、专委会、监委会和仲裁委员会。

**三、大赛主题**

　　推动教学创新 打造一流课程

**四、大赛目标**

　　(一)落实以本为本。强化人才培养的中心地位和本科教学的基础地位，运用先进的教学理念，优化教学目标，设计教学内容，创新教学方法，改革考核方式，通过教学改革促进学习革命。

　　(二)推动教授上讲台。倡导教师“回归本分”，推动教授走进本科生课堂，引导教师热爱教学、倾心教学、研究教学，潜心教书育人，成为德高、学高、艺高的名师，担当起学生健康成长的指导者和引路人。

　　(三)推进智慧教育。提高教师现代信息技术与教育教学深度融合的能力，鼓励教师积极探索智慧教育新形态，充分利用信息技术开展教学模式改革，推动信息化手段服务高校教育教学。

　　(四)强化学习共同体。发挥基层教学组织的作用，鼓励高校以教研室、课程组、教学团队等基层教学组织为基础，建设学习共同体，形成传帮带机制，开展教学研究与指导，推进教学改革与创新。

　　(五)引导分类发展。引导各类高校顺应高等教育普及化时代的多样化发展趋势，适应信息化时代的教学新要求，结合教师教学发展的不同特点和发展实际，推动高校教师队伍建设分类发展。

**五、参赛对象**

　　全国普通本科高等学校在职或正式聘用教师，主讲教师近五年对参赛的本科课程讲授3轮及以上。以个人或团队形式报名，鼓励以团队形式参赛，团队成员包括1名主讲教师和不超过3名团队教师。

**六、大赛赛制**

　　大赛分校赛、省(自治区、直辖市)赛(以下简称省赛)、全国赛三级赛制。具体如下：

　　(一)校赛

　　各高校根据各省赛方案，按时完成校内比赛，选拔参加省赛的教师，报送至大赛各赛区组委会牵头单位(详见附件1-1)。

　　(二)省赛

　　各赛区组委会牵头单位负责组织省内高校教师开展省赛，须于2021年4月20日前上报全国赛参赛教师名单(名额分配详见附件1-2)。

　　省赛组织方式原则上应与全国赛一致，并适当考虑推荐参加全国赛教师的学科分布和职称结构。

　　(三)全国赛

　　全国赛拟于2021年5月启动，7月上旬在复旦大学举行现场比赛。全国赛共设部属高校(含省部合建高校)类和地方高校类两个赛道，每个赛道根据主讲教师专业技术职务等级分正高组、副高组、中级及以下组三个组别。各赛区推荐参加全国赛的教师中，正高组人数不少于总人数的1/3。

**七、比赛环节及材料要求**

　　(一)比赛环节

　　比赛环节主要包括网络评审和现场评审。评审标准见附件2。

　　1.网络评审

　　参赛教师在规定时间内将课堂教学实录视频、课程教学创新成果报告等材料上传到大赛报名系统，由专家评委进行网络评审。其中，课堂教学实录视频占总成绩50%，课程教学创新成果报告占总成绩的15%。

　　2.现场评审

　　现场评审以教学创新设计汇报为主。参赛教师结合教学大纲和教学实践，全面说明整门课程的设计思路，突出教学改革与创新，展示相关过程性支撑资料。汇报时间不超过15分钟，专家评委提问交流时间不超过10分钟。教学创新设计汇报占总成绩的35%。

　　(二)材料要求

　　1.参赛教师需提交的材料

　　(1)申报书。参赛教师基本情况、课程教学创新情况等(详见附件3-1)。

　　(2)课程教学大纲。课程教学大纲需反映参赛教师教学思想、课程设计思路和教学特色(具体要求详见附件3-2)。

　　(3)课程教学创新成果报告。课程教学创新成果报告应基于参赛课程的教学实践经验与反思，全面体现课程教学的创新成效，注重体现以下三方面内容：第一，明确说明课程教学创新解决了教学中的哪些“痛点”问题，注重问题导向;第二，突出课程教学改革过程中贯彻“以学生为中心”的教育理念，全面反映提升课程教学质量的创新思路、举措、效果及反思，注重信息技术在课堂教学中的应用;第三，通过基于数据、案例等证据的可靠分析，说明问题解决的情况和效果，并分析其推广应用的价值。课程教学创新成果报告须有摘要约300字，正文字数不超过4000字。

　　(4)课堂教学实录视频及相关材料。实录视频为参赛课程中2学时的完整教学实录(约90分钟的1个视频或分别约45分钟的2个视频，视频格式标准详见附件3-3)。实录视频须在真实的高校课堂环境中录制，有参赛主讲教师出镜、有师生互动的镜头，能够充分体现“以学生为中心”的教学创新，严禁“表演式”课堂。相关材料包括：课堂教学实录视频信息表(详见附件3-4)、课堂教学实录视频内容对应的教案和课件，以及其他有助于表明课堂教学内容、教学过程、教学效果的材料。

　　参赛教师提交的相关材料(申报书除外)和现场汇报环节中不得出现参赛教师姓名及所在学校等相关信息。

　　2.赛区组委会需提交的材料

　　(1)推荐参加全国赛的教师名单(详见附件4)。

　　(2)赛区工作总结。赛区工作总结包括但不限于比赛基本概况、奖项设置与颁发、效果与亮点、存在问题与建议等内容。

**八、奖项设置**

　　(一)校赛和省赛

　　校赛和省赛的奖项设置参照全国赛执行，获奖人数原则上不超过参赛人数的30%。

　　(二)全国赛

　　1.个人(团队)奖。按组别分设一、二、三等奖。

　　2.专项奖。根据作品特点遴选出教学活动创新奖、教学学术创新奖、教学设计创新奖等专项奖。

　　3.基层教学组织奖。对有效促进教师教学成长与发展并获得良好成绩的基层教学组织，授予“优秀基层教学组织奖”。

　　4.优秀组织奖。对积极推荐教师参赛并获得良好成绩的赛区和高校组织单位，授予“优秀组织奖”。

This webpage is from 中国教育在线 (EOL.cn) announcing the "Notice on Hosting the First National College Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition" (首届全国高校教师教学创新大赛), issued by the China Association of Higher Education (中国高等教育学会) under document number 高学会〔2020〕107号. The notice was published on 2020-10-27.

The competition aims to implement national education conference directives and the "China Education Modernization 2035" plan, promote "quality revolution" in higher education, and adopt new engineering, agriculture, medicine, and liberal arts construction concepts.

Key details:
- **Organizers**: Guided by the Ministry of Education Higher Education Department; hosted by China Association of Higher Education; co-hosted by Fudan University, Beijing Institute of Technology, Nanjing University, Zhejiang University, UESTC, Xi'an Jiaotong University, and Chaoxing Information Technology.
- **Theme**: "Promoting Teaching Innovation, Creating First-class Courses"
- **Five goals**: Implementing "undergraduate-first" education, promoting professors teaching undergraduate courses, advancing smart education, strengthening learning communities, and guiding classified development.
- **Participants**: Full-time or formally employed teachers at regular undergraduate universities who have taught their entry course 3+ times in the past 5 years. Individual or team entry (max 4 members: 1 lead teacher + up to 3 team teachers).
- **Competition structure**: Three levels - school level, provincial level, and national level. National competition to start May 2021 with on-site competition at Fudan University in early July. Two tracks: ministry-affiliated universities and local universities, each divided into senior, associate, and junior/mid-level professor groups.
- **Scoring**: Video recordings of classroom teaching worth 50%, course teaching innovation achievement report worth 15%, and teaching innovation design presentation worth 35%.
- **Submission requirements**: Application form, syllabus, course innovation report (max 4000 words with ~300-word abstract), and 2-class-hour teaching video recording (90 minutes total), with emphasis on avoiding "performed" classrooms and ensuring student-centered teaching.
- **Awards**: Individual/team awards by group; special awards for teaching activity innovation, teaching academic innovation, teaching design innovation; plus "Outstanding Grassroots Teaching Organization Award" and "Outstanding Organization Award."
- **Website**: http://nticct.cahe.edu.cn (opened October 20, 2020).
- **Deadline**: Provincial competitions must submit national competition participant lists by April 20, 2021; senior professor group must constitute at least 1/3 of each province's nominees.
- Contact personnel listed for Fudan University, Chaoxing Information Technology, and the China Association of Higher Education.

The page also includes navigation links to EOL.cn's various education services (gaokao, graduate exams, vocational education, international education, etc.) and related news items from the China Association of Higher Education in 2025.

This document contains the official scoring standards and supporting materials requirements for the Fourth National College Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition (第四届全国高校教师教学创新大赛).

**Scoring Standards for Groups 1-3 (First Three Groups):**

1. **Classroom Teaching Video Recording (40 points):** Evaluates teaching philosophy (student-centered, moral education, "四新" [Four New] construction), teaching content (depth, breadth, higher-order thinking, innovation, challenge level, industry/social relevance), curriculum ideological-political education (课程思政, integrating values with knowledge and ability training), teaching process (student-centered innovation, clear objectives, organized teaching, innovative methods, information technology use, formative assessment), teaching effectiveness (engaging lectures, active student participation, transferable teaching models), and video quality (clear, smooth, authentic).

2. **Teaching Innovation Results Report (20 points):** Requires clear problem orientation (based on real classroom issues, student development focus), obvious innovation characteristics (applying "四新" requirements throughout teaching process), curriculum ideological-political features, attention to technology application in teaching, and radiation/influence of innovation results (evidence-based analysis with transferable new methods/models).

3. **Instructional Design Innovation Presentation (40 points):** Evaluates concept and objectives (student-centered, clear and specific goals), content analysis (knowledge point relationships, key/difficult points), student situation analysis (learning characteristics and starting level), curriculum ideological-political education (organic integration with professional education, typical teaching cases), process and methods (rich activities, creative textbook use, innovative strategies/methods/technology to solve problems, reasonable IT application, autonomous/cooperative/inquiry learning), assessment and feedback (diverse evaluation methods, combining formative and summative assessment), document standards (proper formatting), and design innovation.

**Scoring Standards for Group 4:**

1. **Classroom Teaching Video Recording (40 points):** Emphasizes teaching philosophy and goals (moral education, student development, value shaping combined with knowledge and ability training), teaching content (unity of ideology and academics, deep integration of ideological-political education, meeting industry/social needs, higher-order thinking), teaching process (organized, student-centered, effective IT use, scientific assessment), teaching effectiveness (natural integration of values like "salt dissolving in water," engaging classes, transferable models), and video quality.

2. **Curriculum Ideological-Political Innovation Report (20 points):** Requires problem orientation (finding and solving real problems in ideological-political teaching), innovative measures (specific, targeted, innovative, operable measures in teaching objectives, design, content, methods, and assessment), innovation results (effectively integrating value guidance into knowledge and ability training, shaping correct worldview), and result radiation (case-based analysis with transferable new methods/models for similar courses, disciplines, and schools).

3. **Instructional Design Innovation Presentation (40 points):** Evaluates teaching philosophy, overall design (systematic design integrating ideological-political and professional education), teaching objectives, student situation analysis, content analysis (deep mining of ideological-political resources), process and methods (flexible teaching methods, scientific IT application, typical teaching cases), assessment and feedback (diverse evaluation dimensions), design innovation (integrated design of value guidance, knowledge transmission, and ability training), document standards, and on-site communication (correct viewpoints, clear expression).

**Supporting Materials Requirements (Attachment 3):**
- Materials must NOT contain teacher names, school names, or department names (identity-revealing information), which is reported on the official competition website.
- Main teacher's representative teaching awards (course ideological-political innovation) results (max 5 items): including award date, results name, award category/level, awarding unit, and teacher ranking.
- Talent cultivation achievement certification materials (max 5 items).

**Classroom Teaching Video Recording Standards (Attachment 4):**
1. Videos must be two complete 1-class-hour teaching recordings from the competition course (uploaded as 2 video files).
2. Continuous recording required (no cranes, drones, or recording methods detached from actual classroom teaching; max 2 camera positions; must not affect normal teaching order).
3. Main teacher must appear on camera; students must have camera shots; students must be informed they may appear in the video and that it will be made public.
4. Must reflect teaching innovation; no dubbing, no picture-in-picture, no identity-revealing information.
5. MP4 format, resolution above 720P, each video file max 1200MB, clear and stable images, clear sound.
6. Video files named as "Course Name + Teaching Content."

# 关于举办第六届校教师教学创新大赛的通知

发布者：教师教学发展中心发布时间：2025-09-08浏览次数：81

各二级学院、体育教学部，相关部门：

为进一步推进教育强国建设与高等教育高质量发展，落实立德树人根本任务，助力我校课程思政建设和新工科、新文科建设，推动信息技术与教育教学创新发展，提高产教协同育人成效，做好第六届江苏省高校教师教学创新大赛（以下简称省赛）暨第六届全国高校教师教学创新大赛（以下简称国赛）的选拔推荐工作，我校将举办第六届教师教学创新大赛（以下简称校赛）。现将有关事项通知如下：

一、**校赛主题**

推动教学创新  培养一流人才

二、**校赛目标**

新文科、新工科、基础课程赛道目标：紧扣建设高质量教育体系主题，深入推动高等教育教学改革，有效助力我校新工科、新文科建设。

课程思政赛道目标：充分发挥大赛的示范引领作用，全面推进一流课程和课程思政建设，精心打造我校教师教学创新与交流的标杆。

产教融合赛道目标：引导教师通过课程教学创新，推动产教融合走深走实，提高高校与社会、高校与行业企业协同育人成效，解决人才培养供给侧和产业需求侧的结构性矛盾，实现教育链、人才链与产业链、创新链的有机衔接，全面提高高校拔尖创新人才自主培养质量，提升高校自主创新能力。

新教师赛道为江苏省高校教师教学创新大赛面向新教师能力提升的特色新增赛道，目标是：激励新入职教师积极参与教学实践，促进其教学技能和教学方法的提升，培养新教师的创新意识和团队合作精神，促进我校新教师培训体系建设和基层教学组织建设，提升教师教书育人能力和人才自主培养质量。

三**、校赛内容**

校赛内容与省赛、国赛内容一致，包括课堂教学实录视频、教学创新成果报告（课程思政组为课程思政创新报告、产教融合组为产教融合创新成果报告）、教学设计创新汇报和证明材料。

新教师赛道（只有省赛、没有国赛）参考省赛标准。评审内容包括课堂教学实录视频、教学实施报告和现场说课展示。

**四、参赛对象及名额分配**

（一）参赛对象 

我校在职教师或正式聘用教师。具体要求如下：

1.参赛教师无师德师风、学术不端等问题，近三年无教学事故。

2.（1）新工科、新文科、基础课程、课程思政赛道：主讲教师近5年对参赛的本科课程讲授2轮及以上。以个人或团队形式报名，若以团队形式参赛，团队成员包括1名主讲教师和不超过3名团队教师。（2）产教融合赛道：主讲教师近5年讲授参赛课程（应列入本科专业培养方案的课程）2轮及以上，国家急需战略性新兴领域和紧缺专业领域建设的新课程可适度放宽。以团队形式参赛，团队成员包括1名主讲教师和不超过3名团队教师（至少包含1名从行业企业聘请的兼职教师，且深度参与教育教学时间2年及以上）。（3）新教师赛道：新入职教师（2024年1月1日后取得教师资格证），年龄需在40周岁以下，以个人形式参赛。

3.往届校教创赛特获奖获得者（如计划竞争省赛名额）无需参加本次选拔赛，但要提前准备各项参赛材料，与本次选拔赛的优胜者一并竞争省赛名额。往届校教创赛其他等级获奖者可报名参加本次选拔赛，如获奖等级超出之前等级成绩，则予以认定，否则不认定、不重复奖励。

（二）组别设置及名额分配

校赛设新工科、新文科、基础课程（公共基础课或专业基础课，但不局限于此）、课程思政、产教融合、新教师等6大组。

其中新工科、新文科、基础课程、课程思政赛道，各二级学院、体育教学部可推荐正高、副高、中级及以下参赛对象共3名（个人或团队），根据参赛课程自行选择组别。专任教师数超过50人的学院可增加1-2名。

产教融合赛道，要求承担江苏省产教融合一流课程建设的团队积极申报，但不局限于此。

新教师赛道，各二级学院、体育教学部可推荐2024年1月1日后取得教师资格证、年龄在40周岁以下的新入职教师1-2名参赛。

鼓励人工智能、集成电路、量子科技、储能技术、智能制造、数字经济（含区块链）、国际传播等相关专业领域和耕读教育、“理解当代中国”（外语专业）等相关课程的教师积极报名参赛。

**注：**往届校赛特等奖获得者参赛，不占学院名额，学院仍需正常推荐教师参赛。

**五、校赛环节、****内容和成绩**

**（一）院部****选拔****推荐及材料报送**

各二级学院、体育教学部积极组织本单位选拔赛，于9月12日前，将选拔赛日程安排表（附表1）（Excel和盖章的PDF）发送至电子邮箱；10月10前，将推荐教师（团队）汇总表（附表2）（Excel和盖章的PDF）发送至电子邮箱。

10月19日前，参赛教师通过校赛网站（另行通知）提交材料，申报书样式详见附表4-1，其他材料含报告（教学设计创新成果报告/课程思政创新报告/产教融合创新成果报告/教学实施报告）、教学创新成果支撑材料目录（新教师赛道无）、课堂教学实录视频（校赛可只交1个完整学时）及配套材料（课程教学大纲、课堂教学实录2个完整学时视频内容对应的教案和课件）。其中新教师赛道交1个学时视频和对应1个学时视频的配套材料。

（二）**校级比赛**

校赛分两个阶段。第一阶段为网络评审，评审内容包括课堂教学实录视频、教学创新成果报告（或课程思政创新报告或产教融合创新成果报告或教学实施报告），根据网络评审成绩由高到低排名，选取优秀教师（团队）进入第二阶段现场评审，即现场汇报环节。主要内容为教学设计创新汇报（新教师赛道为现场说课展示）及提问交流。

**1.网络评审**

由评审专家对参赛选手的教学实录视频和教学创新成果报告（或课程思政创新报告或产教融合创新成果报告或教学实施报告）进行会议评审，遴选每组优秀的选手进入现场评审环节。网络评审满分为60分，其中课堂教学实录视频成绩占40分、教学创新成果报告（或课程思政创新报告或产教融合创新成果报告或教学实施报告）成绩占20分。

网络评审定于第8周（10月20日-10月26日）。

**2.现场评审**

现场评审阶段，参赛教师结合教学大纲和教学实践，进行不超过15分钟的教学设计创新汇报，评审专家依据参赛教师的汇报进行10分钟的提问交流。新教师赛道的主讲教师需进行15分钟的现场说课展示，评审专家依据参赛教师的汇报内容进行10分钟的提问交流。现场评审满分为40分。

现场评审定于第9-10周（10月27日-11月9日），具体时间、地点另行通知。

**3.计分方式**

网络评审成绩（总分60分）与现场评审（总分40分）成绩之和为参赛教师（团队）的最终成绩，由高到低进行排序评奖，具体各项评分细则详见附表3。

**六、材料要求**

（一）申报书

参赛教师通过校赛网站提交材料。

（二）教学创新成果报告（或课程思政创新报告或产教融合创新成果报告或教学实施方案）

1.教学创新成果报告（新工科、新文科、基础课程组）应基于参赛课程的教学实践经验与反思，体现课程教学的创新举措、过程与成效。聚焦教学实践的“真实问题”，通过课程内容的重构、教学方法的创新、教学环境的创设、教学评价的改革等，采用教学实验研究的范式解决教学问题，明确教学成效及其推广价值。

2.课程思政创新报告（课程思政组）应立足于学科专业的育人特点和要求，发现和解决本课程开展课程思政教学过程中的真实问题。

3.产教融合创新成果报告（产教融合组）应密切围绕高校与社会或行业企业主动合作、人才培养规格与产业需求、学科专业结构与区域发展、组织模式创新与教学模式改革等产教融合方面的内容，以教学研究的范式，聚焦教学实践中的“真实问题”，通过课程内容的重构、教学方法的创新、教学环境的创设、教学评价的改革、师资队伍的建设、协同办学的机制等，解决教学问题，明确教学成效及其推广价值。

4.教学实施报告（新教师组）应立足于学科专业的育人特点和要求，聚焦教学实践的“真实问题”，通过课程内容的重构、教学方法的创新、教学环境的创设、教学评价的改革等，体现课程教学的创新举措、过程与成效。

报告包括摘要、正文，字数4000字左右为宜（无模板）。

教学设计创新（或课程思政创新或产教融合创新）成果的支撑材料目录详见附件4-2。

（三）课堂教学实录视频及相关材料

新教师赛道以外的其他赛道实录视频为参赛课程2个学时（校赛可只交1个学时）的完整教学实录，具体要求详见附表4-3。与课堂教学实录视频配套相关材料包括：参赛课程的教学大纲、课堂教学实录视频内容对应的教案和课件（须交2个学时对应的材料），其中教学大纲（参考模板见附表5）主要包括课程名称、课程性质、课时学分、学生对象、课程简介、课程目标、课程内容与教学安排、课程评价等要素。

新教师赛道：实录视频为参赛课程1个学时的完整教学实录，具体要求详见附表4-3。与课堂教学实录视频配套相关材料包括：参赛课程的教学大纲、课堂教学实录视频内容对应的教案和课件（交1个学时对应的材料），其中教学大纲（参考模板见附表5）主要包括课程名称、课程性质、课时学分、学生对象、课程简介、课程目标、课程内容与教学安排、课程评价等要素。

（四）证明材料

**产教融合赛道：**须截图以PDF格式上传教务系统中课程已完成学期的开设信息，参赛课程名称须与教务系统中显示情况一致，由教务处出具参赛课程的实践性教学内容比例证明，应不少于30%。行业企业参与教学相关证明，即人事聘任协议或产教融合项目合同等，签订时间在2年及以上。

以上材料请于2025年10月19日24:00前上传校赛网（另行通知）。

**七、奖项设置和奖励**

本次校赛设个人（团队）奖与优秀组织奖。

（一）个人（团队）奖。设特等奖、一等奖、二等奖若干，由学校颁发荣誉证书，可按规定申报教学奖励。优秀的参赛教师（团队）将优先推荐参加省赛。

（二）优秀组织奖。对大赛开展过程中，教师参与度高、大赛成绩突出、影响效果明显的学院（部），授予“优秀组织奖”。

**八、其他事项**

（一）全国高校教师教学创新大赛是教育部高等教育司指导的、中国高等教育学会主办的全国性高校教师教学创新大赛。江苏省赛在江苏省教育厅指导下，由江苏省高等教育学会主办，省内高校承办。

（二）各二级学院、体育教学部应高度重视、积极组织院（部）级比赛，严格审查参赛教师资格，做好校赛的选拔推荐工作。综合考量教师教学常态、教学评价、教学成果等因素，及教师运用先进教学理念、信息技术开展课堂教学改革等情况，确定参加校赛教师（团队）名单。

（三）参赛教师应保证教学创新设计相关材料的原创性，不得抄袭、剽窃他人作品，如产生侵权行为或涉及知识产权纠纷，由参赛教师自行承担相应责任。

（四）参加江苏省教创赛教师所需提交的相关材料（申报书除外）和现场汇报环节中的相关材料均不得出现参赛教师姓名、所在学校及院系名称等透露个人身份的信息。

This is an official notice from Changzhou Institute of Technology (常州工学院) announcing the 6th University Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition (第六届校教师教学创新大赛), published on September 8, 2025. The competition serves as the internal selection mechanism for the 6th Jiangsu Provincial and 6th National University Teacher Teaching Innovation Competitions.

**Theme and Goals:** The competition theme is "Promoting Teaching Innovation, Cultivating Top-tier Talent" (推动教学创新 培养一流人才). The competition has six tracks (组): New Engineering (新工科), New Liberal Arts (新文科), Basic Courses (基础课程), Curriculum Ideological-Political (课程思政), Industry-Education Integration (产教融合), and New Teachers (新教师). Goals include advancing university teaching reform, promoting curriculum ideological-political construction, deepening industry-education integration, and supporting new teachers' skill development.

**Eligibility:** Teachers must have no ethics or academic misconduct issues and no teaching accidents in the past three years. Main teachers for most tracks must have taught the course at least 2 rounds in the past 5 years. New teacher track requires certification obtained after January 1, 2024, and age under 40. Teams can include 1 main teacher and up to 3 members (industry-education track requires at least 1 industry-appointed part-time teacher with 2+ years involvement).

**Quota Allocation:** Each college can recommend 3 participants for the New Engineering, New Liberal Arts, Basic Courses, and Curriculum Ideological-Political tracks; colleges with over 50 full-time teachers can add 1-2. New teachers track allows 1-2 per college. Previous special award winners don't count toward college quotas.

**Timeline and Process:**
- September 12, 2025: Submit selection schedule to organizer
- October 10, 2025: Submit recommended teachers summary
- October 19, 2025, 24:00: Deadline for materials submission
- Week 8 (October 20-26): Online evaluation (60 points total: teaching video 40 pts, innovation report 20 pts)
- Weeks 9-10 (October 27-November 9): On-site evaluation (40 points, 15-min presentation + 10-min Q&A)

**Materials Required:** Application form, teaching innovation achievement report (or curriculum ideological-political report, or industry-education integration report, or teaching implementation report) of approximately 4,000 words, classroom teaching video (1 full class hour for campus competition), course syllabus, lesson plans, courseware, and supporting materials. Industry-education track requires proof of at least 30% practical teaching content and 2+ year industry-enterprise cooperation agreements.

**Awards:** Special prizes, first prizes, and second prizes awarded. Outstanding participants receive priority recommendation for the provincial competition. Colleges with high participation and excellent results receive "Outstanding Organization Awards."

**Contact:** 陈老师 (Chen) and 苗老师 (Miao), phone 88510172 (extension 6172), email jsfz@oa.czu.cn, office at 文新楼809室.

The notice also includes six attachment files (schedule form, teacher summary form, scoring standards, application form, supporting materials catalog, video standards, syllabus template, and competition flowchart). Note that competition materials must not reveal teacher names, school, or department information for provincial competition.

# 关于举办学校首届教师教学创新大赛的通知

时间：2021-01-13浏览：1006

各教学院部：

根据《关于举办首届全国高校教师教学创新大赛的通知》（高学会[2020]107号）（**附件1**）和《教育部高等教育司转发<关于举办首届全国高校教师教学创新大赛的通知>的函》的文件精神及要求，学校拟举办首届教师教学创新大赛，现将相关事宜通知如下：

**一、大赛主题**

推动教学创新 打造一流课程

二、**参赛对象**

我校在职或正式聘用教师，主讲教师近五年对参赛的本科课程讲授3轮及以上。以个人或团队形式报名，鼓励以团队形式参赛，团队成员包括1名主讲教师和不超过3名团队教师。

**三、比赛安排**

各院部报名人数不限，比赛设置正高组、副高组、中级及以下组三个组别，分为三个阶段。

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **比赛阶段** | **内容** | **时间** |
| 第一阶段 | 学校组织专家对参赛教师的《申报书》（详见**附件3-****1**）、《课程教学大纲》（详见**附件3-****2**）、《课程教学创新成果报告》（要求见**附件1**）进行评审，确定参加第二阶段比赛的选手名单。 | 1月25-29日 |
| 第二阶段 | 教学创新设计汇报。参赛教师结合教学大纲和教学实践，说明整门课程的设计思路，突出教学改革与创新，展示相关过程性支撑材料。汇报时间不超过15分钟。 | 3月1-5日（具体时间另行通知） |
| 第三阶段 | 课堂教学实录视频评审。进入第二阶段参赛教师提交课堂教学实录视频及相关材料（要求见**附件1**），学校组织专家进行评审。综合考虑三个阶段比赛成绩，最终确定获奖教师名单。 | 3月13-15日 |

**四、奖项设置**

比赛设一、二、三等奖，获奖名额根据参赛教师情况确定。届时将择优推荐获奖教师参加山东省教师教学创新大赛。

**五、有关要求**

1.各院部应高度重视“学校首届教师教学创新大赛”工作，积极做好院部选拔推荐工作，具体评审标准见**附件2**。

2.请各教学院部于**1月15日12:00之前**报送《推荐教师汇总表》（**附件4**）并加盖学院公章，参赛教师请加入**QQ群：892590352**。

3.请各教学院部于**1月25日12:00之前**提交比赛第一阶段所需《申报书》《课程教学大纲》《课程教学创新成果报告》等材料。

4.请各教学院部于**3月12日17:00****之前**提交课堂教学实录视频（标准详见**附件3-3**）及相关材料。相关材料包括:课堂教学实录视频信息表(详见**附件3-4**)、课堂教学实录视频内容对应的教案和课件，以及其他有助于表明课堂教学内容、教学过程、教学效果的材料。

5.**所有材料**的电子版请发送至：LXH2014@upc.edu.cn。

 

其他未尽事宜，请与党委教师工作部、教师教学发展中心联系，联系人：刘旭华，联系电话：0532-86983202。

# 关于开展浙江师范大学第十五届青年教师教学竞赛的通知

发布者：zjnuku发布时间：2024-06-10浏览次数：405

根据《关于举办第七届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛的通知》（总工办发〔2024〕11号）、《关于开展浙江省第十三届高校青年教师教学竞赛的通知》（浙教工〔2023〕4号），为广泛深入持久开展好劳动和技能竞赛，大力弘扬劳模精神、劳动精神和工匠精神，进一步推动高校青年教师队伍建设改革，提升广大高校青年教师的教学能力和业务水平，经研究决定，开展浙江师范大学第十五届青年教师教学竞赛，现将有关事项通知如下。

围绕立德树人根本任务，以加强师德师风建设、锤炼教学基本功为着力点，充分发挥教学竞赛在提高教师队伍素质中的示范引领作用，进一步激发广大高校青年教师更新教育理念和掌握现代教学方法的热情，努力造就一支有理想信念、有道德情操、有扎实学识、有仁爱之心的高素质专业化创新型教师队伍，推动学校一流本科教育事业持续发展。

**三、竞赛学科和参赛对象**

（一）竞赛学科。竞赛学科分设四个组别：

第一组为文科（含01哲学，02经济学，03法学，04教育学，05文学，06历史学，12管理学，13艺术学）；

第二组为理科（含07理学、10医学）；

第三组为工科（含08工学，09农学）；

第四组为思想政治课专项。

（二）参赛对象。全校各学院（单位）从事教育教学工作的青年教师均可报名。各学院（单位）推荐参加决赛的选手为1984年8月31日后出生。

**四、竞赛内容及流程**

以“上好一门课”为竞赛理念，本次竞赛由教学设计、课堂教学和教学反思三部分组成，三部分分数分别为20分、75分、5分。评分细则见附件4、5、6。

（一）教学设计

教学设计是指以1个学时为基本单位，对教学活动的设想与安排。主要包括课程名称、学情分析、教学目标、教学思想、课程资源、教学内容、教学重点与难点、教学方法与工具、教学安排、教学评价、预习任务与课后作业等。

选手需准备参赛课程1个学时的教学设计方案。

（二）课堂教学

课堂教学规定时间为20分钟。评委主要从教学内容、教学组织、教学语言与教态、教学特色四个方面进行评审。选手需准备参赛课程1个学时相对应的教学节段的PPT，课堂教学内容要与提交的教学设计内容对应、一致。

（三）教学反思

参赛选手结束课堂教学环节后，进入指定教室，结合本节段课堂教学实际，从教学理念、教学方法和教学过程三方面着手，在45分钟内完成对本讲课节段的教学反思材料（500字以内）。要求思路清晰、观点明确、联系实际，做到有感而发。反思室提供电脑，不允许携带任何书面或电子等形式的资料。

（四）注意事项

1.选手参赛课程的实际学分要求不得少于2个学分（含2个学分）。

2.选手在教学设计、课堂教学、教学反思中提交的材料不得出现姓名、学校等任何与个人相关的信息。

3.课堂教学采取“无生上课”的形式，并全程录像，视频版权归学校所有。

**五、竞赛实施**

竞赛分初赛和决赛两个阶段，时间覆盖全年。

（一）院级初赛

1.初赛由学院（系）负责组织。各学院（系、教学单位）结合所在学院（系）实际情况，总结历年办赛经验，分别开展院级青年教师教学比赛活动。

2.建议初赛比赛内容、形式与学校决赛保持一致，评委委员由专家、同行、督导及学生等组成。

3.学院（系）根据参赛教师的初赛表现择优遴选决赛人选，并对参加学校决赛的教师给予专业性的指导和培训。

4.各学院根据名额分配（见附件1）选送参加校决赛的选手。

    （二）校级决赛

学校成立由分管校领导任组长，人事处、教务处、校工会等部门主要负责人任副组长，各学院教学副院长任成员的第十五届青年教师教学竞赛领导小组，负责学校赛组织评选工作。决赛将于2024年11月中下旬进行，具体时间地点另行通知。

    （三）材料提交

各参赛学院按分配名额选送参赛选手。统一提交以下相关资料（均为电子版），材料包括：

    （1）本学院竞赛活动总结。包括活动组织实施情况、参赛人数、特色亮点等，作为评选优秀组织奖的重要依据，格式为PDF文档通用格式。

    （2）参赛选手推荐表1份（单位盖章后的扫描件）（附件2）及参赛人员汇总表1份（附件3）。 10月20日前由学院发送到jfzx@zjnu.cn邮箱。

    （3）教学大纲。按照学校统一格式填写，格式为PDF文档通用格式。

    （4）教学设计。1个学时（45分钟）的教学设计方案，格式为PDF文档通用格式。

    （5）教学节段PPT。与参赛课程相对应的教学节段的PPT（20分钟），格式为Powerpoint演示文稿16:9大小。教学大纲、教学设计和教学节段PPT材料正文一级标题用3号黑体加粗；二级标题用4号黑体加粗；三级标题用小4号黑体加粗。正文内容用小4号宋体，1.5倍行距。

各学院须在校决赛前统一上传材料提交中的(3)(4)(5)材料至校青年教师教学竞赛系统，系统网址与截止时间另行通知。

    （6）系统上传的文档材料中不得出现选手姓名、学院等相关信息。

（四）奖项设置

初赛阶段，学院可以根据实际，评选出若干名获奖者，给予一定的奖励。决赛阶段，学校评选出校“教学十佳”、 “课程思政先锋”奖、教学优胜奖和优秀组织奖若干。已获前十四届校青年教师教学竞赛一、二等奖者参加比赛，不占本届竞赛“教学十佳”名额，表现突出者可授予“教学十佳特别奖”。学校将从获奖人员中择优推荐参加省级青年教师教学技能比赛。

本次青年教师教学竞赛同时也是浙江省高等学校第十四届青年教师教学技能竞赛和全国高校青年教师第八届教学竞赛的选拔赛。请各学院（单位）高度重视，广泛宣传发动，精心组织实施，吸引高水平青年教师积极参与，充分展示我校青年教师的教学风采。

**六、赛事联系**

args.summary:
This webpage is an official announcement from Zhejiang Normal University (浙江师范大学) Kansas Joint Education College (堪萨斯联合教育学院) regarding the organization of the 15th Young Teachers' Teaching Competition (第十五届青年教师教学竞赛). The announcement was published on June 10, 2024 (issued June 4, 2024), with 405 views.

**Purpose:** To implement national and provincial directives (7th National Young Teachers' Teaching Competition and 13th Zhejiang Province competition) to promote teaching skill development, professional growth, and high-quality education among young university teachers.

**Competition Categories:** Four groups -
1. Humanities (philosophy, economics, law, education, literature, history, management, arts)
2. Sciences (natural sciences, medicine)
3. Engineering (engineering, agriculture)
4. Ideological and Political Courses (special category)

**Eligibility:** All young teachers at the university. Finalists must have been born after August 31, 1984.

**Competition Components:** Based on "teaching one lesson well" philosophy, three parts totaling 100 points:
- Teaching Design (教学设计): 20 points - Develop a 1-class-hour (45 min) teaching design plan
- Classroom Teaching (课堂教学): 75 points - 20-minute presentation with PPT, evaluated on content, organization, language/demeanor, and distinctive features ("no students" format, fully recorded)
- Teaching Reflection (教学反思): 5 points - 500-word reflection written within 45 minutes in a dedicated room (no materials allowed)

**Process:**
- **College-level preliminaries:** Organized by each college throughout the year; winners selected based on performance
- **University finals:** Held mid-late November 2024, overseen by a leadership group led by a vice president with HR, academic affairs, and union department heads
- **Materials deadline:** October 20, 2024, submit via email to jfzx@zjnu.cn (recommendation forms, summaries, and rosters required)

**Required materials (electronic format):** Competition summary, recommendation forms, teaching syllabus, teaching design (45 min), and teaching segment PPT (20 min, 16:9). Documents must not contain personal identifiers.

**Awards:** University-level "Top Ten Teachers" (教学十佳), "Course Ideological Pioneer" awards, Teaching Excellence awards, and Outstanding Organization awards. Previous 1st/2nd prize winners from the last 14 competitions don't count toward Top Ten quotas but may receive a special "Top Ten Special Award." Winners may be recommended for provincial competitions. This also serves as selection for the 14th Zhejiang Provincial and 8th National competitions.

**Contact:** 郑然心 (Zheng Ranxin), phone 82283951, email jfzx@zjnu.cn

关于举办第五届全国高校教师教学创新大赛的通知

来源：中国高等教育学会 作者：中国高等教育培训中心 发布时间：2025-03-21

**各省、自治区、直辖市高等教育学会，行业高等教育学会，各分支机构，各赛区牵头单位，有关高校：**

为深入学习贯彻全国教育大会精神，落实《教育强国建设规划纲要（2024-2035年）》，进一步推进高等教育高质量发展，打造高校教学改革的风向标，经教育部批准，中国高等教育学会决定启动第五届全国高校教师教学创新大赛（以下简称大赛）。现将有关事项通知如下：

**一、举办单位**

指导单位：教育部高等教育司

主办单位：中国高等教育学会

承办单位：北京理工大学、复旦大学、西安交通大学、浙江大学、电子科技大学、南京大学

支持单位：北京世纪超星信息技术发展有限责任公司

**二、大赛主题**

推动教学创新  培养一流人才

**三、大赛目标**

紧扣教育强国建设目标，深入推动高等教育教学改革，有效助力新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科建设，全面推进课程思政建设，推动产教融合走深走实，精心打造高校教师教学创新与交流的标杆。

**四、大赛内容**

大赛内容包括课堂教学实录视频，教学创新成果报告或课程思政创新报告、产教融合创新报告（以下简称创新成果报告），教学设计创新汇报。

**五、参赛对象**

全国普通本科高等学校（含军队院校）在职教师，其中主讲教师近5年对所参赛的本科课程讲授2轮及以上。产教融合赛道以团队形式参赛，团队成员至少包含1名从行业企业聘请的兼职教师，且深度参与教育教学时间须达到2年及以上；其他赛道以个人或团队形式参赛均可。若以团队形式参赛，团队成员包括1名主讲教师和不超过3名团队教师。

已获得往届大赛全国赛一等奖的主讲教师不能再次参赛，已获得上届大赛全国赛二、三等奖的主讲教师不能连续参赛。

**六、大赛实施**

大赛采用校赛、省（自治区、直辖市、新疆生产建设兵团）赛（以下简称省赛）、全国赛三级赛制。校赛、省赛由各赛区依据大赛通知及实施方案负责组织实施。

（一）校赛

各高校根据各省赛方案，保质保量按时完成校内比赛，选拔参加省赛的教师（团队）。

（二）省赛

各赛区牵头单位负责组织赛区内的省赛，并于2025年6月10日15:00前在大赛官网上传全国赛参赛教师（团队）名单。

（三）全国赛

全国赛具体事项另行通知。

**七、组织机构**

大赛设组织委员会、专家委员会、纪律与监督委员会和仲裁委员会。组织委员会下设组委会秘书处。

**八、大赛官网**

大赛网址：[nticct.cahe.edu.cn](http://nticct.cahe.edu.cn)

技术联系方式：宁立霞 15010870307、靳盼利18911601757、孔岑 18396834320

**九、其他事项**

（一）各高校和各赛区要认真做好大赛组织与推荐工作，严格审查参赛教师（团队）资格。有以下情形者不得参赛：有学术不端或者师德失范行为的；在政治、学习、科研和生活等方面有违法、违规、违纪情况的。

（二）参赛教师（团队）应保证参赛材料的原创性，不得抄袭、剽窃他人作品，如产生侵权行为或涉及知识产权纠纷，由参赛教师（团队）自行承担相应责任。

（三）参赛教师（团队）提交的相关材料（申报书除外）和现场汇报环节中均不得出现参赛教师（团队）姓名、所在高校及院系名称等透露个人身份的信息，产教融合赛道行业企业信息不做硬性要求。

（四）涉密课程应做脱密处理后参赛，如无法脱密不建议参赛。

**十、联系人及联系方式**

（一）北京理工大学

联系电话：010-68918966、010-81382227

This is an official notice from the China Association of Higher Education (中国高等教育学会), published on the website of the China Higher Education Training Center (中国高等教育培训中心) on March 21, 2025, announcing the launch of the 5th National College Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition (第五届全国高校教师教学创新大赛).

**Key details:**
- **Guiding organization:** Higher Education Department of the Ministry of Education (教育部高等教育司)
- **Organizer:** China Association of Higher Education
- **Host institutions:** Beijing Institute of Technology, Fudan University, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Zhejiang University, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, and Nanjing University
- **Supporting organization:** Beijing Century Chaoxing Information Technology Development Co., Ltd.
- **Theme:** "Promoting Teaching Innovation, Cultivating First-Class Talent" (推动教学创新 培养一流人才)

**Competition objectives:** To deepen higher education teaching reform, support the construction of new engineering, new medical, new agriculture, and new liberal arts disciplines, comprehensively advance curriculum ideological and political education, and promote deep industry-education integration.

**Competition content:** Includes classroom teaching video recordings, teaching innovation achievement reports (or curriculum ideological-political innovation reports, or industry-education integration innovation reports), and teaching design innovation presentations.

**Eligibility:** Full-time teachers at ordinary undergraduate institutions in China (including military academies) who have taught the competition course for 2 or more rounds in the past 5 years. The industry-education integration track requires team participation with at least one part-time teacher appointed from industry, with deep teaching involvement of 2+ years. Teams may consist of 1 lead teacher and up to 3 team members. Previous national first-prize winners cannot compete again; previous second/third-prize winners from the last edition cannot compete consecutively.

**Implementation structure:** A three-level competition system of university-level (校赛), provincial-level (省赛), and national-level (全国赛) competitions. Provincial organizers must upload national competition participant lists to the official website by June 10, 2025, at 15:00.

**Restrictions:** Teachers with academic misconduct, teacher ethics violations, or illegal/regulatory violations cannot participate. Materials must be original; anonymous review is required (no names, university names, or department info in materials or oral presentations, except for the application form; industry-enterprise information exempt in the industry-education track). Classified courses must be declassified before participation.

**Official website:** nticct.cahe.edu.cn

**Contact information:** Beijing Institute of Technology (Jiang Minwei, Sun Jinru; 010-68918966, 010-81382227; jwservice@bit.edu.cn); China Association of Higher Education (Guang Hao, Xue Xiaojing; 010-82289129). Technical support: Ning Lixia (15010870307), Jin Panli (18911601757), Kong Cen (18396834320).

## 会议简介

为进一步推进教育强国建设与高等教育高质量发展，落实立德树人根本任务，提高教师教书育人能力，强化科技教育和人文教育协同，打造高校教学改革的风向标，经教育部批准，中国高等教育学会决定启动第六届全国高校教师教学创新大赛（以下简称“大赛”）。

大赛设组织委员会、专家委员会、纪律与监督委员会和仲裁委员会。组织委员会下设秘书处。

组织委员会负责大赛的组织实施；专家委员会负责项目评审等工作；纪律与监督委员会负责对赛事组织、参赛项目评审等进行监督；仲裁委员会负责对大赛的投诉、违反大赛纪律的行为予以处理。

大赛目标

紧扣教育强国建设目标，深入推动高等教育教学改革，有效助力新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科建设，全面推进课程思政建设，推动产教融合走深走实，深化人工智能技术赋能教学创新，构建新型实验教学体系，精心打造高校教师教学创新与交流的标杆。

大赛内容

（一）大赛设新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科、基础课程、课程思政、产教融合、人工智能、实验教学，共9个赛道。比赛内容包括课堂教学实录视频、创新成果报告和教学设计创新汇报。

（二）大赛设置高校教师教学创新学术研讨会、教师教学能力提升系列交流活动、新时代高水平高校教师队伍建设成果展等系列活动。

## 参会对象

* 全国普通本科高等学校和军队院校的在职教师，其中主讲教师近5年对所参赛的本科课程讲授2轮及以上，且参赛课程需纳入本科人才培养方案。
* 已获得往届大赛全国赛一等奖的主讲教师不能再次参赛，已获得上届大赛全国赛二、三等奖的主讲教师不能连续参赛。

## 注册征文

**大赛实施**

大赛采用校赛、省（自治区、直辖市、新疆生产建设兵团）赛（以下简称“省赛”）、全国赛三级赛制。校赛、省赛由各赛区依据大赛通知及实施方案负责组织实施。

（一）校赛

各高校根据各省赛方案，保质保量按时完成校赛，负责审核作品资格，选拔参加省赛的教师（团队）。

（二）省赛

各赛区牵头单位负责组织赛区内的省赛，保质保量按时完成省赛，负责审核作品资格，选拔参加国赛的教师（团队）。

（三）全国赛

全国赛具体事项另行通知。

**大赛官网**

网 址：nticct.cahe.edu.cn

预计上线日期：2026年2月27日

**其他事项**

（一）各高校和各赛区要认真做好大赛组织与推荐工作，严格审查参赛教师（团队）资格。有以下情形者不得参赛：有学术不端或师德失范行为的；有违规违纪违法情况的。

（二）参赛教师（团队）应保证参赛材料的原创性，不得抄袭、剽窃他人作品，如产生侵权行为或涉及知识产权纠纷，由参赛教师（团队）自行承担相应责任。

（三）参赛教师（团队）提交的相关材料（申报书和创新成果支撑材料、证明材料原始版本除外）和现场汇报环节中均不得出现参赛教师（团队）姓名、所在高校及院系名称等透露个人身份的信息，产教融合赛道对行业企业信息不做硬性要求。

（四）涉密课程应做脱密处理后参赛，如无法脱密不建议参赛。

（五）为进一步发挥优秀教学成果的示范引领作用，全国赛获奖课程的课堂教学实录视频经授权后，将上线国家智慧教育公共服务平台（网址：www.smartedu.cn）进行展示。

## 产业简报

2026年全国高校教师教学创新行业发展趋势简报

一、核心趋势：政策引领下的全学科创新融合

2026年第六届全国高校教师教学创新大赛以“教育强国建设”为核心目标，明确提出推动新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科（简称“四新”）与课程思政、产教融合、人工智能、实验教学的深度融合。这一趋势与国家《教育强国建设规划纲要（2024-2035年）》中“强化科技教育与人文教育协同”的要求高度契合，标志着高校教学创新从单一学科突破转向全学科生态重构。例如，大赛设置的9个赛道中，“人工智能+实验教学”“产教融合+课程思政”等跨领域组合成为亮点，反映政策对复合型人才培养的导向。

二、关键技术方向：AI赋能与实验体系重构

大赛内容凸显两大技术方向：

**人工智能技术深度应用**：通过“课堂教学实录视频分析”“AI辅助教学设计创新汇报”等环节，推动AI从工具升级为教学核心要素。例如，北京世纪超星信息技术发展有限责任公司作为支持单位，其智能教学平台已在全国多所高校试点，实现课堂行为数据实时采集与个性化反馈。

**新型实验教学体系构建**：以“虚拟仿真实验”“跨学科综合实验”为载体，破解传统实验“重验证、轻创新”的痛点。西安交通大学承办的“新工科实验教学赛道”中，参赛项目需展示如何通过数字孪生技术实现能源、制造等领域的产学研协同实验。

三、政策驱动因素：教育强国与产教融合双轮驱动

**顶层设计强化**：教育部高等教育司作为指导单位，将大赛纳入“高等教育数字化转型”重点工程，要求参赛项目必须体现“四新”建设成果，并与地方产业需求对接。

**资源分配倾斜**：政策明确支持高校将大赛获奖成果转化为教学成果奖申报、一流课程建设等资源，形成“以赛促建”的闭环。例如，浙江大学已将大赛纳入教师职称评审加分项，激励教师参与创新实践。

四、产学研生态：高校主导、企业支撑的协同网络

**研究机构与高校引领**：南京大学、复旦大学等承办单位联合成立“全国高校教学创新联盟”，发布《高校教学创新白皮书》，输出行业标准；电子科技大学牵头组建“人工智能教育实验室”，聚焦AI伦理、算法偏见等前沿问题。

**企业深度参与**：高等教育出版社有限公司开发“课程思政资源库”，为教师提供跨学科案例；北京理工大学与华为合作设立“产教融合创新基金”，资助教师开展智能汽车、工业软件等领域的实践教学改革。

五、企业行动建议：聚焦三大场景

**技术赋能场景**：开发支持跨学科教学创新的工具链，如AI辅助的课程设计平台、虚拟仿真实验开发工具包。

**资源整合场景**：搭建产学研对接平台，例如将企业真实项目转化为教学案例库，或联合高校共建“产业学院”。

**评价服务场景**：基于大赛评审标准，为高校提供教学创新能力诊断服务，输出定制化改进方案。

六、行业应用与就业机会

**应用领域**：教学创新成果已渗透至智能制造、生物医药、乡村振兴等产业。例如，南京理工大学“新农科赛道”获奖项目“智慧农业数字孪生系统”被多家农业科技企业采购。

**招聘岗位**：高校新增“教学创新研究员”“AI教育产品经理”等岗位；企业端需求集中于“教育解决方案架构师”“产教融合项目经理”，要求兼具技术理解与教学场景设计能力。

**结语**：2026年大赛标志着全国高校教师教学创新进入“政策-技术-产业”深度融合的新阶段。高校、企业与政府需协同构建“创新-应用-反馈”的生态闭环，以教学创新驱动高等教育高质量发展，最终服务教育强国战略目标。

## 会议简评

args.summary:
This webpage announces the 6th National College Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition (第六届全国高校教师教学创新大赛) for 2026, scheduled from February 27 to December 31, 2026, in Beijing. Approved by the Ministry of Education and hosted by the China Association of Higher Education (中国高等教育学会), the competition aims to advance education power building, deepen higher education teaching reform, support the "Four New" disciplines (new engineering, medicine, agriculture, liberal arts), promote curriculum ideology and politics construction, deepen industry-education integration, leverage AI to empower teaching innovation, and build a new experimental teaching system.

The competition features 9 competition tracks: New Engineering, New Medicine, New Agriculture, New Liberal Arts, Basic Courses, Curriculum Ideology and Politics, Industry-Education Integration, Artificial Intelligence, and Experimental Teaching. Each track includes classroom teaching recording videos, innovation achievement reports, and teaching design innovation presentations. Related activities include academic seminars, teacher capability improvement exchanges, and achievement exhibitions.

The competition uses a three-level structure: school-level (校赛), provincial (省赛), and national (全国赛) competitions. Eligibility requires full-time teachers at national undergraduate universities and military academies who have taught their courses at least 2 rounds in the past 5 years, with courses included in the undergraduate talent training plan. Previous first-prize winners cannot re-compete, and second/third-prize winners from the last national competition cannot compete consecutively.

Key regulations: participants with academic misconduct, ethics violations, or violations of laws/discipline cannot compete; materials must be original; no identifying information (names, institutions) may appear in submitted materials or presentations; classified courses require declassification; winning classroom recordings will be uploaded to the National Smart Education Platform (www.smartedu.cn) with authorization. The competition website (nticct.cahe.edu.cn) is expected to launch on February 27, 2026. Registration deadline is February 27, 2026.

Organizers: China Association of Higher Education (host); Nanjing University, Nanjing University of Technology, Fudan University, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Zhejiang University, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, and Beijing Institute of Technology (co-organizers). Supported by Beijing Century Chaoxing Information Technology Co., Ltd. and Higher Education Press Co., Ltd. Guided by the Ministry of Education's Department of Higher Education. Contact persons include Song Xiaoqing (Nanjing University, 025-89681130), Zhang Jushang (Nanjing University of Technology, 025-84303197), and Gao Shan, Lü Zhengjun, Xue Xiaojing (China Association of Higher Education, 010-82289129).

An industry briefing highlights trends including policy-led interdisciplinary innovation integration, AI deep application in teaching, new experimental teaching system construction, and the "innovation-application-feedback" ecosystem closed loop. The competition is rated with a recommendation index of 9, with an estimated attendance of 2,000-3,000 people. Industries such as smart manufacturing, biomedicine, and rural revitalization have adopted competition outcomes, and new job roles like "teaching innovation researcher" and "AI education product manager" are emerging.

**大赛定位：**教创赛是经教育部批准，纳入《教育部直属单位三评一竞赛保留项目清单》的赛项之一，是目前项目清单中唯一一项高校教师教学竞赛活动。

**大赛机制：**大赛分校赛、省赛、全国赛三级赛制，分设课程思政、基础课程、“四新”、产教融合、**人工智能（新增）**赛道进行比赛，赛事信息可参考上一届通知（附件1、2）。

### 校赛安排：

#### （1）组织动员

请各学院、各课程组以大赛为契机，认真总结课程建设成果，凝练课程教学理念与目标、总结教学创新举措、创新成效，发挥成果辐射作用，组织动员本院、本课程组老师积极参赛。根据以往省赛要求，推荐参赛队伍中正高组主讲教师不少于1/3，请着力动员正高级教师报名参赛。

#### （2）教师申报

请报名参赛的老师填写申报材料，包括申报书（附件3）、教学创新成果报告、教学创新成果支撑材料目录（附件4）。其中**教学创新成果报告包括摘要、正文，字数4000字左右为宜（可参照附件5提供的提纲）**。请于**2026年1月9日**前将三份材料发送至邮箱：dxj01@ustc.edu.cn，邮件主题请写明“第六届教创赛校赛参赛材料提交”，三份材料请以“姓名+所在院级单位+申报书/创新成果报告/支撑材料目录”命名。

#### （3）校赛评奖与省赛推荐

教务处教师教学发展中心将邀请校内外专家对申报材料进行线上评审，并组织参赛教师进行现场教学设计创新汇报。具体时间及安排另行通知。

根据申报材料线上评审得分（满分20分）和现场汇报得分（满分40分），综合评定校赛获奖教师（团队）。在省赛名额分配后，根据省赛要求，择优推荐校赛获奖老师参加省赛。

This webpage is from the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) Office of Academic Affairs (教务处), primarily containing a notice about the 6th National Higher Education Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition (教创赛) campus-level competition. The page also includes navigation menus for USTC teaching resources (course selection, academic plans, grades, graduation, etc.) and contact information for the Office of Academic Affairs.

**Competition Notice Details:**
- The notice announces the launch of USTC's campus-level competition for the 6th National Higher Education Teacher Teaching Innovation Competition, published on December 2, 2025.
- The competition aims to promote educator spirit, support curriculum ideological-political education ("课程思政"), basic courses, "Four New" initiatives (new engineering, medicine, agriculture, and liberal arts), industry-education collaboration, and integration of AI with higher education teaching.
- The competition is the only university teacher teaching competition on the Ministry of Education's "Three Evaluations One Competition" retention list.
- **Eligibility:** Current or formally employed USTC teachers who have taught an undergraduate course 2 or more times within the last five years. Participation can be individual or team-based (1 lead teacher + up to 3 team members).

1. **Organization & Mobilization:** Colleges and course groups should summarize course construction achievements; at least 1/3 of recommended teams should have lead teachers with senior titles (正高).

　　紧扣教育强国建设目标，深入推动高等教育教学改革，有效助力新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科建设，全面推进课程思政建设，推动产教融合走深走实，深化人工智能技术赋能教学创新，构建新型实验教学体系，精心打造高校教师教学创新与交流的标杆。

　　四、大赛内容

　　大赛设新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科、基础课程、课程思政、产教融合、人工智能、实验教学，共9个赛道。比赛内容包括课堂教学实录视频、创新成果报告和教学设计创新汇报。

　　五、参赛对象

　　北京市普通本科高等学校和军队院校的在职教师，其中主讲教师近5年对所参赛的本科课程讲授2轮及以上，且参赛课程需纳入本科人才培养方案。

　　往届大赛已被推荐参加全国赛的主讲教师不能再次参赛。

　　六、大赛实施

　　大赛分为校内推荐、市级比赛两个阶段。具体如下：

　　(一)校级比赛

　　各高校负责自行组织本校教师校内比赛报名选拔工作，并择优选拔推荐参加市级比赛的教师个人(教师团队)，需适当考虑推荐教师的赛道及组别分布。

　　(二)市级比赛

　　市级比赛评审工作拟于2026年4月启动。4月中上旬进行网络评审，4月下旬在中国农业大学举行现场评审，具体事项另行通知。

　　七、组织机构

　　大赛设组织委员会、专家委员会、纪律与监督委员会和仲裁委员会。

　　八、大赛官网

　　大赛网址：nticct.cahe.edu.cn

　　九、其他事项

　　(一)各高校要认真做好大赛组织与推荐工作，认真审查参赛教师(团队)资格。有以下情形者不得参赛：有学术不端或师德失范行为的;有违规违纪违法情况的。

　　(二)参赛教师(团队)应保证参赛材料的原创性，不得抄袭、剽窃他人作品，如产生侵权行为或涉及知识产权纠纷，由参赛教师(团队)和推荐高校承担相应责任。

　　(三)参赛教师(团队)提交的相关材料(申报书和创新成果支撑材料、证明材料原始版本除外)和现场汇报环节中的相关材料均不得出现参赛教师(团队)姓名、所在高校及院系名称等透露个人身份的信息，产教融合赛道对行业和企业信息不做硬性要求。

　　(四)涉密课程应做脱密处理后参赛，若不能脱密则不能参赛。

　　(五)本通知自发布之日起施行，解释权归大赛组织委员会所有。

　　十、联系人及联系方式

　　联 系 人：姜 蔺、光 昊

　　联系电话：010-62736971、010-81382227

　　邮 箱：bjticct@126.com

This is an official notice from the Beijing Municipal Education Commission (Higher Education Division) announcing the 6th Beijing College Teachers' Teaching Innovation Competition (第六届北京高校教师教学创新大赛), published March 2, 2026. Key details:

- **Organizers**: Hosted by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission Higher Education Division; organized by China Agricultural University, Beijing Institute of Technology, Peking University, Renmin University of China, and Capital Normal University.
- **Theme**: "Promote Teaching Innovation, Cultivate Top Talents" (推动教学创新 培养一流人才).
- **Goals**: To advance higher education reform, support new engineering/medicine/agriculture/liberal arts disciplines, promote curriculum-based ideological-political education, deepen industry-education integration, apply AI to teaching innovation, and build new experimental teaching systems.
- **Content/Categories**: 9 tracks — new engineering, new medicine, new agriculture, new liberal arts, basic courses, curriculum ideology-politics, industry-education integration, artificial intelligence, and experimental teaching. Competition components include classroom teaching videos, innovation achievement reports, and teaching design innovation presentations.
- **Participants**: In-service teachers from Beijing regular undergraduate institutions and military academies; the lead teacher must have taught the undergraduate course at least 2 rounds within the past 5 years, and the course must be part of the undergraduate talent cultivation plan. Teachers previously recommended for the national competition in past events cannot compete again.
- **Implementation**: Two phases — (1) school-level competitions organized by each university for selection/recommendation, and (2) municipal-level competition with online review in early-to-mid April 2026 and on-site review at China Agricultural University in late April 2026.
- **Structure**: Competition has organizing, expert, discipline/supervision, and arbitration committees.
- **Official website**: nticct.cahe.edu.cn
- **Restrictions**: Teachers with academic misconduct, teaching ethics violations, or violations against discipline/law cannot participate. Materials must be original; submissions must not reveal teacher identity (name, university, department) except for industry-education integration track where industry/enterprise info is not strictly required. Classified/confidential courses cannot compete unless declassified.
- **Contact persons**: Jiang Lin (姜蔺) and Guang Hao (光昊); phones: 010-62736971, 010-81382227; email: bjticct@126.com.
- Notice issued February 28, 2026 by the Higher Education Division of Beijing Municipal Education Commission. Attachments include a Word document and PDF of the notice.

# 关于开展西藏大学青年教师教学竞赛暨第八届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛培育工作的通知

时间：2025-09-08 作者： 编辑：教务处

各学院、各部门：

为引导我校青年教师立足教学岗位、倾心教书育人，夯实教学基本功、提升教学能力水平，并切实做好第八届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛（以下简称“青教赛”）参赛准备，充分发挥工会、教务处在引领岗位建功、实施职工素质建设工程中的职能作用，助力我校青年教师在全国青教赛中展现风采、争创佳绩，校工会与教务处拟于近期联合举办西藏大学2025年青年教师教学竞赛暨第八届全国高校青年教师教学竞赛培育工作。现就有关事项通知如下。

## 一、赛事简介

全国高校青年教师教学竞赛由中华全国总工会与教育部联合主办，由中国教科文卫体工会与教育部教师工作司联合承办，旨在打造一个服务教育改革、助力教师教学能力提升的建功立业品牌。赛事自2012年启动以来，每两年举办一届，现已成为参与面最广、学科门类最全、组织规模最大的全国性高水平教学类竞赛，被纳入全国总工会“十四五”全国引领性劳动和技能竞赛，通过以赛促训、以赛促学、以赛促教，为广大青年教师提供了实践历练、成长成才的广阔舞台。

学校比赛获奖教师拟按学校本科教学奖励实施办法予以表彰奖励。根据全国总工会的相关规定，获得国赛各组别第一名且符合条件的选手，可按程序申报“全国五一劳动奖章”。

## 二、工作目标

## 三、组织领导

成立办公室，负责竞赛事项的全面组织。成立评审委员会，负责竞赛评委工作。

**（一）办公室。**成员由校工会、教务处相关人员组成，负责竞赛日常工作。

**（二）评审委员会。**成员由相关专业的教学名师和知名专家教授组成，独立、公正开展评审工作。

## 四、参赛范围及对象

#### **（一）参赛范围：**

全校各专业在职教师。

#### **（二）参赛对象：**

1.40周岁（含）以下青年教师（1985年8月31日后出生）；

2.近2年（2023—2025学年）持续从事一线教学工作；

3.每个学院按照不低于符合条件人数的10%（向上取整）推荐参加学校竞赛。

## 五、选拔标准

**（一）****师德师风：**政治立场坚定，热爱教育事业，遵守国家宪法和法律，贯彻党的教育方针，自觉践行社会主义核心价值观，具有良好的思想政治素质和师德师风修养。

**（二）****教学能力：**教学设计科学规范，课堂感染力强，教学成果显著。

**（三）****创新潜力：**具备教学改革意识，能灵活运用现代教育技术或创新教学方法。

**（四）****优先推荐：**获校级及以上教学竞赛类奖项者优先。

#### **（五）****有下列情况之一者不得参加教学竞赛：**

1.近一年内发生过重大教学事故；

2.师德师风有不良记录。

## 六、竞赛分组

比赛分设两个组别

**第一组：**（学科门类为：01 哲学、02经济学、03法学、04教育学、05文学、06历史学、12管理学、13艺术学、思想政治课专项）；

**第二组：**（学科门类为：07理学、08工学、10医学）。

## 七、竞赛内容及计分方法

竞赛坚持“上好一门课”理念，设置教学设计、课堂教学两部分竞赛内容。竞赛总分为100分，教学设计、课堂教学两部分分值分别为20分、80分（具体评分细则分别见附件1、2）。

**（****一****）****教学设计。**教学设计是指以1个学时为基本单位对教学活动的设想与安排。主要包括课程名称（注明对应的参赛课程大纲章节）、教学指导思想、内容分析、学情分析、教学目标与教学重难点、教学过程设计等。选手需准备参赛课程16个学时的教学设计方案，每个学时的教学设计方案注明对应的参赛课程大纲章节。评委将对整套教学设计方案进行打分。

**（****二****）****课堂教学。**课堂教学规定时间为20分钟。评委主要从教学内容、教学组织、教学语言与教态、教学特色四个方面进行现场评审。选手需准备参赛课程16个学时相对应的16个课堂教学节段的PPT，课堂教学内容要与提交的教学设计内容对应一致。

**（三）****计分方法。**评委评分实行实名制。选手的每部分得分为去掉一个最高分和一个最低分后的平均分，总得分为三部分得分之和。为确保比赛的公平公正，对在比赛过程中出现赛事违纪违规行为的选手，将在其总得分中予以扣分处理（扣分规定见附件5）。

## 八、竞赛材料

**（一）****教学大纲。**

主要包含课程名称、基本信息（课程性质、教学时数学分、学生对象）、课程简介、课程目标、课程内容与教学安排、课程评价、建议阅读文献等要素。

**（二）****教学设计。**

16个学时的教学设计方案，格式为PDF文档通用格式。

**（三）****课堂教学节段PPT。**

与16个学时教学设计方案相对应的16个课堂教学节段的PPT，格式为Powerpoint演示文稿16:9大小，分辨率为1600×900。

竞赛材料正文一级标题用3号黑体加粗，二级标题用4号黑体加粗，三级标题用小4号黑体加粗。正文内容用小4号宋体，1.5倍行距。

选手须以光盘形式提交竞赛材料和相关音频、视频文档。

## 九、培育措施

**（一）****名师指导：**学校比赛结束后，将组建专家指导团队，开展“一对一”指导和集中辅导。

**（二）****专项培训：**组织开展教学技能工作坊、教学研讨等活动，按学科分组培训。

**（三）****实战演练：**开展模拟竞赛、同行评课、专家反馈，提升参赛经验。

**（四）****组织保障：**校工会、教务处做好培育教师的资源协调和全方位支持保障工作。

## 十、工作流程

**（一）****基层推荐：**各学院自行组织院级比赛选拔青年教师参加学校竞赛。

**（二）****学校遴选：**校工会、教务处组织开展学校青教赛评比工作。

（三）校工会、教务处对校级优秀人选按照上级部门名额分配及组别进行备赛指导培育工作。

## 十一、说明

（一）根据各自参赛课程需要，选手可携带教学模型挂图等教具。

（二）课堂教学现场比赛环节采取“无生上课”的形式。

（三）学校竞赛时间预计在10月下旬，具体比赛时间、地点另行通知。

## 十二、工作要求

（一）各学院要高度重视、广泛动员、有力组织，支持鼓励广大青年教师积极参加指导培育工作，持续激发广大青年教师更新教育观念和掌握现代教学方法的热情，进一步推动本部门青年教师队伍建设工作。

（二）参加学校备赛指导及培育工作的教师，需统筹安排好个人的教学科研任务，保证将主要精力投入到培训工作，切实提升备赛指导成效。

（三）请各学院将《报名表》（附件1）和《汇总表》（附件2）电子版及盖章PDF版于2025年10月9日（周四）前发送至指定邮箱。

（四）联系人：杨晓英；电话：6835102；邮箱：xzdxjfzx@163.com。

args.summary:
This is an official notice from Tibet University (西藏大学) dated September 8, 2025, issued by the university's Education Union (教育工会) and Academic Affairs Office (教务处), announcing the Tibet University 2025 Young Teacher Teaching Competition and preparation work for the 8th National College Young Teacher Teaching Competition (青教赛).

Key details:
- The National College Young Teacher Teaching Competition is co-hosted by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and the Ministry of Education, held biennially since 2012. It is the largest national high-level teaching competition. National competition first-place winners may apply for the "National May 1st Labor Medal."
- Competition structure: An Office (composed of union and academic affairs staff) and an Evaluation Committee (composed of teaching masters and experts) will be established.
- Eligibility: Teachers under 40 years old (born after August 31, 1985), who have continuously taught frontline courses for the past 2 years (2023-2025 academic years), and each college must recommend at least 10% (rounded up) of eligible teachers.
- Selection criteria: Political integrity/ethics, teaching ability, innovation potential, priority given to those with teaching competition awards. Exclusion criteria include major teaching accidents in the past year or poor ethics records.
- Two competition groups: Group 1 (Philosophy, Economics, Law, Education, Literature, History, Management, Art, and Ideological-political courses) and Group 2 (Science, Engineering, Medicine).
- Scoring: Total 100 points - Instructional Design (20 points) and Classroom Teaching (80 points). Teachers must prepare 16 class hours of teaching design documents and 16 corresponding PPT teaching segments. Classroom teaching is 20 minutes, using "no-student teaching" format.
- Competition materials must be submitted on CD-ROM, with specified formatting (3rd-level black bold fonts for main headings, 1.5 line spacing).
- Training measures: expert mentoring, special training workshops, simulation competitions, and organizational support.
- Timeline: College-level competitions first, school selection, then preparation guidance for provincial/national competitions. School competition expected late October; registration deadline is October 9, 2025.
- Contact: 杨晓英 (Yang Xiaoying), phone 6835102, email xzdxjfzx@163.com.
- Five attachments include registration forms, scoring rubrics for both sections, and disciplinary violation handling rules.

This is an official notice from the Jiangsu Provincial Federation of Trade Unions, Jiangsu Provincial Department of Education, and the Jiangsu Provincial Communist Youth League Committee announcing the Fourth Provincial University Young Teachers' Teaching Competition (and the selection for the 6th National University Young Teachers' Teaching Competition). Key details:

**Organization:**
- Hosts: Provincial Federation of Trade Unions, Provincial Department of Education, Provincial Youth League Committee
- Organizer: Provincial Education, Science and Technology Trade Union
- Co-organizer: Hohai University (河海大学)
- Competition Committee Leadership: Director - Vice Chairman Jing Liangqiang; Deputy Directors include Deputy Director of Education Pan Man, Deputy Youth League Secretary Xiong Jun, Education and Science Trade Union Chairman Kou Fang, and Hohai University Vice President Xu Feng

**Timing & Location:**
- Finals held July 12-14, 2022 at Hohai University Xikang Road Campus (No.1 Xikang Road, Gulou District, Nanjing)
- Registration deadline: June 27, 2022 (email qjshhu@163.com)
- Materials submission via online system (http://1.13.246.224/) June 28 - July 2, 2022
- Paper materials due by July 4, 2022
- Check-in by 12:00 on July 12, 2022 at Nanjing Gudunadu Hotel (No. 208 Guangzhou Road, Gulou District)

**Competition Categories:** Five groups - Liberal Arts, Science, Engineering, Medicine, and Ideological-Political Theory (special category)

**Eligibility:** Full-time university teachers under age 40 (born after December 31, 1981). General bachelor's universities may choose 2 groups (Double First-Class universities may choose 3, organizer may add 1), with 1 teacher per group. Independent colleges and vocational colleges selected by municipal education trade unions with varying group limits per city.

**Competition Components (total 100 points):**
1. Teaching Design (教学设计) - 20 points; 20 class hours of teaching design plans
2. Classroom Teaching (课堂教学) - 72 points; 20 minutes, "no-students teaching" format, fully recorded; 20 PPT segments
3. Teaching Reflection (教学反思) - 5 points; written within 45 minutes, max 500 words
4. Ideological-Political Course Construction Basic Knowledge Test (课程思政建设基础知识测试) - 3 points; closed-book written test with multiple choice, multiple response, and true/false questions (45 minutes)

**Awards:**
- Each group: 1 Grand Prize (特等奖), first and second prizes (first prize max 5 per group)
- Grand Prize winners representing Jiangsu nationally may be recommended for "Jiangsu Provincial May 1st Labor Medal"
- Grand Prize and first prize winners receive "Jiangsu Provincial May 1st Innovation Expert" title
- Winners under 35 (born after May 1, 1987) may apply for "Jiangsu Provincial Young Post Expert"
- Grand Prize and first prize winners apply for "Jiangsu Provincial Technical Expert"
- Excellent Organization Awards awarded to about 1/3 of participating units

**Key Requirements:**
- Course must be at least 2 credits
- Materials must not contain personal identifying information (names, schools, regions)
- All finalists must take the ideological-political test to qualify for awards
- Closed-loop management; shuttle bus between hotel and venue; green Su Kang Code, itinerary code, 48-hour nucleic acid test proof, and commitment forms required due to COVID-19 protocol
- Competition video copyright belongs to Competition Committee Office
- QQ group: 799605520 for inquiries

#### 关于组织参加第八届重庆市高校青年教师教学竞赛的通知

更新时间:2026-03-06  浏览:次  来源:教务处

围绕立德树人根本任务，以加强师德师风建设、锤炼教学基本功为着力点，充分发挥教学竞赛在提高教师队伍素质中的示范引领作用，以赛促学、以赛促教、以赛促训，进一步激发广大高校青年教师更新教育理念和掌握现代教学方法的热情，努力造就一支有理想信念、有道德情操、有扎实学识、有仁爱之心的高素质、专业化的青年教师队伍，推动重庆高等教育事业高质量发展。

（一）竞赛学科

第一组：文科（含 01 哲学，02 经济学，03 法学，04 教育学，05 文学，06 历史学，12 管理学，13 艺术学）；

第二组：理科（含07理学）；

第三组：工科（含08 工学，09 农学）；

第四组：医科（含10 医学）；

第五组：思想政治理论课专项。

每个竞赛组别各推荐1名选手参赛（学校无相关竞赛组别的，可不推荐选手参赛），最多共5名。

（二）参赛对象

在编在岗40周岁以下青年教师（1985年8月31日后出生），遵守国家宪法和法律，贯彻党的教育方针，自觉践行社会主义核心价值观，具有良好的思想政治素质和师德师风修养，近3学年（2024年-2026年）持续从事一线教学工作。

三、竞赛实施

（一）初赛。各高校根据工作实际，自行在校内组织初赛。

（二）决赛。决赛暂定于5月下旬或6月上旬在重庆电子科技职业大学（两江办学点）举行，具体时间另行通知。

（三）奖励。竞赛结束后，将组织召开竞赛总结会，对获奖选手和单位进行表彰。本次竞赛设个人奖、组织工作优秀集体和优秀个人奖。

1.**个人奖**：根据《重庆市工会劳动和技能竞赛管理暂行办法》（渝工发〔2022〕2号）文件精神，根据参赛人数，五个学科组别**分本科院校和高职院校两个序列**，分别设置特、一、二、三等奖若干。

2.**组织工作优秀集体和优秀个人奖**：根据《重庆市工会劳动和技能竞赛管理暂行办法》（渝工发〔2022〕2号）文件精神，对竞赛组织工作成绩突出的单位和个人颁发组织工作优秀集体和优秀个人奖。

四、决赛内容及流程

以“上好一门课”为竞赛理念，本次竞赛由教学设计、课堂教学两部分组成，分值分别为30分、70分。

（一）教学设计

1.教学设计是指以1个学时为基本单位对教学活动的设想与安排。主要包括课程名称（注明对应的参赛课程大纲章节)、教学指导思想、内容分析、学情分析、教学目标与教学重难点、教学过程设计等。

2. 选手需准备参赛课程16个学时的教学设计方案，评委将对整套教学设计方案进行打分。文科组、理科组、工科组、医科组各参赛课程的16个教学设计，其中融入课程思政不少于5个学时；思想政治理论课专项组的16个教学设计，其中融入《习近平关于工人阶级和工会工作的重要论述》不少于5个学时。

（二）课堂教学

1. 课堂教学规定时间为**20****分钟**，参赛者面向评委，用普通话授课。评委主要从教学内容、教学组织、教学语言与教态、教学特色四个方面进行评审。选手需准备参赛课程16个学时相对应的16个课堂教学节段的 PPT（**文理工医科组，融入课程思政不少于****5****个；思想政治专项组，融入《习近平关于工人阶级和工会工作的重要论述》不少于****5****个**），课堂教学内容要与提交的教学设计内容对应、一致。

2. 根据各自参赛课程需要，选手可携带教学模型、挂图等，白板笔、翻页器、黑板、教学电脑等由组委会统一提供。

（三）计分方法

评委评分实行实名制，选手成绩在当天竞赛结束后公布。教学设计、课堂教学两部分具体评分细则附后（参见附件 4、5）。统分时去掉一个最高分和一个最低分后的累积分，除以评委人数（不含一个最高分和一个最低分的评委）为选手本环节得分，得分保留小数点后三位。成绩评定采用百分制，选手两个部分的得分相加为最终得分。

（四）注意事项

1.选手在教学设计、课堂教学中提交的材料不得出现任何能透露选手姓名、学校（大纲是复印件或本校编制的，影印时更要清除或覆盖相关内容）信息。如有出现，作违规处理，由竞赛评审委员会讨论后给予降分处理。

2.组委会将在赛前召开参赛单位领队及选手会议，抽签确定选手参赛次序。比赛当天，选手现场抽签确定本人参赛的具体课堂教学节段。

3.课堂教学采取“无学生上课”的形式，并全程直播、录像，视频版权归组委会所有。

4.**如若国赛规则有新的调整，将按照竞赛新要求及时印发补充通知。**

五、校赛程序及要求

本次竞赛由学校工会统筹组织，教务处负责组织校级比赛评选工作，遴选出的选手可参加市级决赛。

（一）各二级学院于2026年3月11日前，将参赛人员《报名汇总表》签章后交教务处214B办公室，电子文档发送邮箱wljwcjs@163.com。 参赛人员应同时准备竞赛材料，具体包括：

（1）教学大纲。主要包含课程名称、基本信息（课程性质、教学时数、学分、学生对象)、课程简介、课程目标、课程内容与教学安排、课程评价、建议阅读文献等要素，格式为PDF文档1个。

（2）教学设计。4个（最终需16个）学时的教学设计方案，格式为PDF文档4个（最终需16个）。

（3）课堂教学节段PPT。与4个学时教学设计相对应的4个（最终需16个）课堂教学节段的 PPT，格式为Powerpoint演示文稿4个（最终需16个）（大小16:9，分辨率为1600 \* 900。最终上传系统时选手须将课堂教学节段PPT和相关音频、视频文档一并上传）。

竞赛材料正文一级标题用3号黑体加粗；二级标题用4号黑体加粗；三级标题用小4号黑体加粗。正文内容用小4号宋体，1.5倍行距。

（二）各二级学院于2026年3月20日前，将选手参赛教学大纲、4个教学设计、4个课堂教学节段PPT电子文档发送邮箱wljwcjs@163.com。

（三）教务处于3月底前择期组织开展校级比赛评选工作。

（四）工会组织获推荐参加市级决赛的人员于2026年4月20日至30日期间完成全国“青教赛”系统报名工作，于5月6日至15日期间完成个人竞赛材料提交工作。

六、其他要求

（一）各二级学院要加强组织领导，广泛发动青年教师积极参加，为教师参赛提供必要的条件和支持，选拔优秀人员参加校级、市级决赛。

（二）各二级学院要深入推进教学竞赛常态化开展，根据《重庆市工会劳动和技能竞赛管理暂行办法》（渝工发〔2022〕2号）文件精神，建立奖励激励机制，激发广大青年教师更新教学理念和掌握现代教学方法的热情，营造“比、学、赶、帮、超”的良好氛围，推动学校教育教学工作高质量发展。

（三）竞赛有关事项以竞赛主办方正式通知、补充通知为准。

七、联系方式

This is the official notice page from the Academic Affairs Office (教务处) of Chongqing University of Arts and Sciences (cqwu.edu.cn), announcing the organization of the 8th Chongqing Municipal Young University Teacher Teaching Competition. The notice, dated March 6, 2026, outlines the full details of the competition organized in conjunction with the university's Labor Union Committee.

COMPETITION STRUCTURE:
- Five competition subject groups: Humanities (philosophy, economics, law, education, literature, history, management, fine arts), Sciences, Engineering (engineering and agriculture), Medical, and Ideological and Political Theory courses
- Each university may recommend up to 5 contestants (1 per group)

ELIGIBILITY: In-service teachers under 40 years old (born after August 31, 1985), with good political and moral character, and at least 3 continuous years (2024-2026) of frontline teaching experience.

PROCEDURE:
- Preliminary round: conducted internally at each university
- Final round: scheduled for late May or early June at Chongqing Electronic Science and Technology Vocational University (Liangjiang campus)
- Individual awards, excellent organization collective awards, and excellent individual awards will be granted, with both undergraduate and vocational college categories

FINAL COMPETITION FORMAT:
- Concept "teach one course well," consisting of teaching design (30 points) and classroom teaching (70 points)
- Teaching design: 16 class-hour teaching design plans required, with at least 5 integrating curriculum ideology/politics (for humanities, sciences, engineering, medical groups) or Xi Jinping's important discourse on the working class and trade unions (for ideological/political group)
- Classroom teaching: 20 minutes, delivered in Mandarin Chinese, evaluated on teaching content, organization, language and demeanor, and teaching features; 16 corresponding PPT segments required
- Anonymous evaluation: no materials may reveal contestant name or school; scoring removes one highest and one lowest score, results at three decimal places

UNIVERSITY-LEVEL PROCEDURE:
- By March 11, 2026: colleges submit signed registration summary forms to Academic Affairs Office room 214B (email: wljwcjs@163.com)
- By March 20, 2026: submit teaching syllabus, 4 teaching designs, and 4 teaching PPT segments (16:9, 1600x900 resolution)
- End of March: university-level selection competition held
- April 20-30, 2026: recommended contestants register in the national "Qing Jiaosai" system; May 6-15: submit competition materials
- Formatting requirements: level-1 headings in 3号 heiti bold, level-2 in 4号, level-3 in small 4号, body text in small 4号 songti with 1.5 line spacing

CONTACTS: Union Committee - Teacher Zhang, phone 49891723; Academic Affairs - Teacher Jiang, phone 49891731.

The page also contains navigation menus for the Academic Affairs Office sections (academic status, teaching operations, practical teaching, teaching construction, teacher development, etc.) and quick links to the educational administration system, graduation thesis management system, and smart teaching platform.

SUMMARY:
<summary>
This is a news article from China's Ministry of Education (moe.gov.cn) reporting on the 6th National College Young Teachers Teaching Competition finals, held April 20-24, 2023, at Tsinghua University in Beijing. The competition was jointly organized by the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and the Ministry of Education.

Key facts:
- Five contestants won first place in their categories: Liang Sisi (Tsinghua University), Zhou Feng (Shandong Normal University), Gao Xiaofeng (Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Zhu Guiquan (Sichuan University), and Zhao Kun (Zhejiang University), in the humanities, sciences, engineering, medicine, and ideological-political course categories respectively.
- Contestants were required to submit a course syllabus, 16 class-hours of instructional design plans, and corresponding classroom teaching section PPTs before the competition.
- In the finals, contestants randomly drew a teaching section to deliver a simulated classroom lesson and write a teaching reflection. Seven judges scored instructional design, classroom teaching, and teaching reflection separately.
- The competition had preliminary and final rounds. Nearly 500,000 young teachers from over 1,800 universities participated in school, municipal, and provincial level competitions, with a 60% university participation rate. 8,550 contestants from 1,501 schools participated in provincial preliminaries, and 158 contestants from 121 schools across 31 provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities) and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps won awards in the finals.
- The Ministry of Education stated that all winners would have their teaching performance reflected in teacher title evaluations and receive preference in related honors/commendations.
- The All-China Federation of Trade Unions said that first-place winners in each category who meet conditions could be nominated for the "National May Day Labor Medal" at the next year's May 1st commendation.
- Since 2012, the federation has organized 5 editions of the college competition and 3 editions for primary/secondary schools, attracting over one million participating teachers. The competition has become the most widely participated, most comprehensive in disciplines, and largest-scale national high-level teaching competition.
</summary>

文：|图：信通学院| 发布时间: 2023-09-01 16:34:47| ![](../.././images/eye.png)

![](../.././images/eye.png)

8月18-22日，第三届全国高校教师教学创新大赛全国现场赛在浙江大学举行。信息与通信工程学院“移动通信系统”课程组以雷霞为主讲教师，熊文汇、凌翔、武畅为团队成员的参赛团队获新工科正高组全国二等奖，是我院在此赛事中的最好成绩。此外，我校共获全国二等奖3项、三等奖1项，副校长孔令讲、教务处处长黄廷祝出席闭幕式。第四届全国高校教师教学创新大赛将由我校承办。

![295C2](/__local/2/E3/39/016F55F921AFB352784D56CBAC1_CAE3D978_295C2.jpg)

![295C2](/__local/2/E3/39/016F55F921AFB352784D56CBAC1_CAE3D978_295C2.jpg)

（左二为雷霞）

“移动通信系统”是通信工程专业的核心课程之一，课程以素质教育为核心，强调教研结合的教学模式。课程组由信息与通信工程学院和通信抗干扰技术全国重点实验室联合组建，采用理论教学、实践教学相结合的教学方法，注重工程素养、人文精神与创新思维的培养，多年来为国内外学术研究、教育、科研与生产培养了大量的出色人才。在几十年的课程发展中，课程逐步建成为校级挑战性学习课程示范课程、校级课程思政示范课程、四川省线下一流课程、四川省课程思政示范课程。

我院高度重视该项赛事，校赛、省赛、国赛全过程跟踪，多次组织专家对课堂教学实录、创新报告、试讲进行评审、指导。

![4AAC5](/__local/4/A1/84/6CE06569202584F7DEE8DBC277D_C862768B_4AAC5.jpg)

![4AAC5](/__local/4/A1/84/6CE06569202584F7DEE8DBC277D_C862768B_4AAC5.jpg)

全国高校教师教学创新大赛由教育部高等教育司指导，中国高等教育学会主办，是“十四五”期间《教育部直属单位三评一竞赛保留项目清单》中唯一本科高校教师教学竞赛活动。本届大赛紧紧围绕“推动教学创新，培养一流人才”主题，旨在落实立德树人根本任务，深入推动高等教育教学改革，助力高校课程思政建设和新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科建设，推动信息技术与高等教育教学融合创新发展，打造高校教师教学创新的标杆展示与交流平台。大赛按照新工科、新医科、新农科、新文科、基础课程、课程思政等领域和参赛教师专业技术职务等级分组，设6个大组，每组下设正高、副高、中级及以下3个小组，共计18个小组，采用校赛、省赛、全国赛三级赛制。

本届大赛于2022年10月正式启动，全国32个赛区1194所高校的83224名教师参加校赛，23088名教师参加省赛，覆盖全部学科门类。465个教师（团队）进入全国赛网络评审，239个教师（团队）进入全国赛现场评审。参赛主讲教师中，高级职称教师占比近70%。经过激烈角逐，72名教师（团队）获一等奖、166名教师（团队）获二等奖、227名教师（团队）获三等奖。
